about: Post-quantum stage of each chain on the site. Stage rules: docs/stages.md. Network results are written by scripts/patrol.py to data/network.json.

stage_basis.en: BIP-360 and BIP-361 are merged into the BIPs repository as Draft. Neither adds a post-quantum signature, so stage 3 needs one on a test network.
stage_basis.zh: BIP-360 和 BIP-361 已以草案状态合并进 BIPs 库。两者都不含抗量子签名，要到 3 档，得先有抗量子签名进入测试网。

algo.en: None yet. BIP-360 hides keys but adds no signature
algo.zh: 暂无；BIP-360 只隐藏公钥，不含签名方案

holder_can_use_today.en: No post-quantum signature exists. The only lever is exposure: unused P2PKH, P2SH, P2WPKH and P2WSH addresses keep the public key off-chain until it is first revealed, while P2PK outputs, reused addresses and Taproot (bc1p) outputs already expose it (BIP-360 exposure table).
holder_can_use_today.zh: 没有抗量子签名。目前唯一的办法是不让公钥上链：从未转出过的老式地址（1、3、bc1q 开头）在第一次转出前公钥不会公开；P2PK 输出、重复使用的地址和 Taproot（bc1p 开头）地址，公钥已经在链上（见 BIP-360 的暴露情况表）。

note.en: Stage 2 rests on BIP-360 and BIP-361 being merged as Draft. Neither is a post-quantum signature, so Bitcoin cannot move past stage 2 until a post-quantum signature reaches a test network.
note.zh: 2 档的依据是 BIP-360 和 BIP-361 已以草案状态合并。两者都不是抗量子签名，所以在抗量子签名进入测试网之前，比特币不会超过 2 档。

today.en: Bitcoin has no post-quantum signature on mainnet, in Bitcoin Inquisition 29.4 or in a merged proposal. Its stage 2 comes from two Draft BIPs that prepare a migration.
today.zh: 比特币的主网、Bitcoin Inquisition 29.4 和已合并的提案中都没有抗量子签名。评为 2 档，是因为有两份为迁移做准备的 BIP 草案。

watch.en: Some coins already show their public key on-chain: old P2PK outputs, reused addresses and Taproot (bc1p) outputs. BIP-360 would add an output type that keeps the key hidden, but it is not a signature scheme.
watch.zh: 部分币的公钥已经暴露在链上：早期的 P2PK 输出、重复使用的地址，以及 Taproot（bc1p 开头）输出。BIP-360 会新增一种隐藏公钥的输出类型，但它不是签名方案。

can.en: Coins in a P2PKH, P2SH, P2WPKH or P2WSH address that has never been spent from keep their public key off-chain. Not reusing addresses keeps it that way.
can.zh: 存放在 P2PKH、P2SH、P2WPKH 或 P2WSH 地址、且从未转出过的币，公钥不在链上。不重复使用地址，就能保持这种状态。

next.en: A post-quantum signature proposal getting a BIP number, or BIP-360 code reaching Bitcoin Inquisition's signet. Either is the next step toward stage 3.
next.zh: 抗量子签名提案获得 BIP 编号，或 BIP-360 的代码进入 Bitcoin Inquisition 的 signet 测试网。任何一项实现，都是迈向 3 档的下一步。

latest_step.text: BIP-362 (public key exposure classes) opened as pull request #2294 and is still open. The newest merged proposal is BIP-361, a Draft since 2026-04-14.
latest_step.zh: BIP-362（公钥暴露分级）以拉取请求 #2294 提出，仍未合并。最近合并的提案是 BIP-361，2026-04-14 起为草案。

milestones.name: BIP-360 Pay-to-Merkle-Root (P2MR): new output type without Taproot's key path, so the public key is not exposed while coins sit. Adds no post-quantum signature.
milestones.zh: BIP-360 P2MR（支付到默克尔根）：一种不带 Taproot 密钥路径的新输出类型，币在存放期间不暴露公钥。本身不含抗量子签名。

status.en: Draft (merged into the BIPs repository; latest version 0.12.1)
status.zh: 草案（已合并进 BIPs 库，最新版本 0.12.1）

milestones.name: BIP-361 Post Quantum Migration and Legacy Signature Sunset: Phase A bars sending to vulnerable outputs 160,000 blocks (~3 years) after activation; Phase B restricts ECDSA/Schnorr spends to a rescue protocol 2 years later.
milestones.zh: BIP-361 抗量子迁移与旧签名停用：A 阶段在激活后第 160,000 个区块（约 3 年）起，禁止向易受攻击的输出转账；B 阶段再过 2 年，用 ECDSA/Schnorr 签名转出只能走救援协议。

milestones.name: BIP-362 Output Public Key Exposure Classification (four classes; no consensus change) is proposed as pull request #2294; it is still open.
milestones.zh: BIP-362 输出公钥暴露分级（分四级，不改共识）以拉取请求 #2294 提出，仍未合并。

milestones.name: BIP-360 implementation in Bitcoin Core (PR #33163)
milestones.zh: BIP-360 在 Bitcoin Core 中的实现（PR #33163）

milestones.name: Bitcoin Inquisition 29.4 (the signet client for testing proposed soft forks) lists BIPs 446, 54, 118, 119, 347, 348 and 349; BIP-360, 361 and 362 are not among them.
milestones.zh: Bitcoin Inquisition 29.4（在 signet 上试验软分叉提案的客户端）收录了 BIP 446、54、118、119、347、348 和 349，不含 BIP-360、361 和 362。

milestones.name: The SHRINCS Working Group posts a first draft of a cryptographic BIP for SHRINCS, a semi-stateful hash-based signature scheme for Bitcoin, to the bitcoindev mailing list.
milestones.zh: SHRINCS 工作组在 bitcoindev 邮件列表发布 SHRINCS 的密码学 BIP 初稿，这是一种为比特币设计的半有状态哈希签名方案。

status.zh: 初稿；没有 BIP 编号

milestones.name: Post-quantum signature candidates (e.g. SHRINCS) discussed on Delving Bitcoin; none has a BIP number
milestones.zh: Delving Bitcoin 论坛在讨论抗量子签名候选方案（如 SHRINCS），均无 BIP 编号

relation.zh: Blockstream 联合创始人兼 CEO

summary.zh: 量子方面的理论成果不改变节奏：比特币会继续按评审和共识推进抗量子签名，路径是 SHRINCS 或其他方案。
summary.en: Says theoretical quantum results change nothing: Bitcoin will keep moving through review and consensus toward post-quantum signatures, via SHRINCS or another scheme.

relation.zh: Blockstream 联合创始人兼 CEO

summary.zh: 回应「比特币找不到量子方案就会被超越」：已经有基于哈希的签名方案 SHRINCS，也有一份 BIP 草案。
summary.en: Replying to an alarmist claim, points to hash-based signatures, SHRINCS and an existing draft BIP.

relation.zh: Casa 联合创始人兼首席安全官
relation.en: Co-founder and Chief Security Officer of Casa

summary.zh: 发文认为量子迁移之争不只是「冻不冻结有风险的币」，而是 ECDSA 失效时怎样把产权损失降到最小。
summary.en: Argues the migration debate is about minimizing property-rights violations if ECDSA stops proving ownership, not only whether to freeze vulnerable coins.

migration.en: BIP-361 (Draft) would first bar sends to quantum-vulnerable outputs and later restrict old signature spends, but it depends on a post-quantum signature BIP that does not exist yet.
migration.zh: BIP-361（草案）提议先禁止向易受量子攻击的输出转账，之后再限制用旧签名花费；但它依赖一个还不存在的抗量子签名 BIP。

exposure.figure_zh: 604 万枚 BTC（占已发行量的 30.2%）
exposure.en: Bitcoin in outputs whose public key is already visible on chain. Other published estimates differ, for example Google Quantum AI (arXiv 2603.28846, 2026-03-30).
exposure.zh: 公钥已经在链上可见的输出里的比特币。其他已发表的估算不尽相同，例如 Google Quantum AI（arXiv 2603.28846，2026-03-30）。

stage_basis.en: EIP-8051 (ML-DSA) and EIP-8052 (Falcon-512) verification precompiles are merged into the EIPs repository as Draft. No public testnet lets holder accounts sign with them yet.
stage_basis.zh: EIP-8051（ML-DSA）和 EIP-8052（Falcon-512）验签预编译已以草案状态合并进 EIPs 库，但还没有公开测试网让持币人账户用它们签名。

holder_can_use_today.en: Nothing at the protocol level.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 协议层暂无。

note.en: About ten client teams build post-quantum consensus clients from the EF's leanSpec (pq.ethereum.org). That work covers validator signatures, not holder accounts, so it does not count toward stage 3.
note.zh: 约十个客户端团队正依据基金会的 leanSpec（pq.ethereum.org）开发抗量子共识客户端。这项工作针对验证者签名，不涉及持币人账户，因此不计入 3 档。

today.en: Ethereum accounts still sign with secp256k1 on mainnet. Its stage 2 comes from Draft EIPs for ML-DSA and Falcon verification.
today.zh: 以太坊主网账户仍使用 secp256k1 签名。评为 2 档，依据是 ML-DSA 和 Falcon 验签的 EIP 草案。

watch.en: Post-quantum work on consensus clients covers validator signatures, not your account. The Foundation's December 2029 target is a plan and is not rated.
watch.zh: 共识客户端上的抗量子工作针对的是验证者签名，与你的账户无关。基金会 2029 年 12 月的目标只是计划，不参与评档。

can.en: There is nothing to switch on at the protocol level yet. Post-quantum wallets offered today are third-party code and are not counted here.
can.zh: 协议层目前没有可以启用的功能。市面上的抗量子钱包都是第三方代码，不计入档位。

next.en: An activation date for the Hegotá upgrade, which lists EIP-8141 (Frame Transaction) as Scheduled for Inclusion, and whether EIP-8051 or EIP-8052 is scheduled too.
next.zh: Hegotá 升级确定激活日期（EIP-8141 帧交易已列为「计划纳入」），以及 EIP-8051 或 EIP-8052 是否也被排进去。

latest_step.text: EIP-8141 (Frame Transaction), which gives accounts a native way to move off secp256k1 keys, was moved to Scheduled for Inclusion in the Hegotá upgrade. No activation date has been set.
latest_step.zh: EIP-8141（帧交易，让账户可以原生弃用现有的 secp256k1 密钥）被列入 Hegotá 升级的「计划纳入」项，尚无激活日期。

milestones.name: EIP-8051 precompile for ML-DSA signature verification
milestones.zh: EIP-8051：ML-DSA 验签预编译

milestones.name: EIP-8052 precompile for Falcon-512 signature verification
milestones.zh: EIP-8052：Falcon-512 验签预编译

milestones.name: EIP-8141 Frame Transaction (account abstraction; route away from secp256k1 keys)
milestones.zh: EIP-8141 帧交易（账户抽象，让账户可以弃用 secp256k1 密钥）

status.en: Draft; Scheduled for Inclusion in Hegotá per EIP-8081; no activation date
status.zh: 草案；EIP-8081 将其列为 Hegotá「计划纳入」；尚无激活日期

milestones.name: Ethereum Foundation post-quantum roadmap hub (fork milestones I*, J*, L*, M*; no dates per fork)
milestones.zh: 以太坊基金会抗量子路线图页面（分叉里程碑 I*、J*、L*、M*，各分叉未标日期）

status.zh: 已发布；页面于 2026-06-27 更新

milestones.name: EF Protocol cluster target: L1 quantum-resistant across all three layers by December 2029, to be reassessed in January 2027
milestones.zh: 基金会协议组目标：2029 年 12 月前让 L1 三个层面全部抗量子，2027 年 1 月重新评估

milestones.name: About ten client teams build post-quantum consensus clients from the EF's leanSpec. This covers validator signatures, not holder accounts, so it does not count toward stage 3.
milestones.zh: 约十个客户端团队正依据基金会的 leanSpec 开发抗量子共识客户端。这项工作针对验证者签名，不涉及持币人账户，因此不计入 3 档。

milestones.name: EIP-8141 is moved to Scheduled for Inclusion in the Hegotá upgrade meta EIP (EIP-8081).
milestones.zh: EIP-8141 被列入 Hegotá 升级元 EIP（EIP-8081）的「计划纳入」项。

milestones.name: EIP-8288 In-mempool signature and proof aggregation: a new EIP-8141 frame mode that aggregates signatures and STARK proofs into one recursive STARK per block, to make post-quantum signatures cheaper to verify. It adds no signature scheme of its own.
milestones.zh: EIP-8288 交易池内签名与证明聚合：为 EIP-8141 帧交易新增一种模式，把签名和 STARK 证明聚合成每个区块一个递归 STARK，降低抗量子签名的验证成本；本身不新增签名方案。

relation.zh: 以太坊官方号（以太坊基金会维护）
relation.en: Official Ethereum account, run by the Ethereum Foundation

summary.zh: 专家在剑桥聚会，协调把以太坊的密码学升级为抗量子的研究。
summary.en: Experts met in Cambridge to coordinate research on upgrading Ethereum's cryptography to be quantum-resistant.

summary.zh: 介绍 EIP-8288（递归 STARK 交易池），希望进入 Hegotá 之后的分叉；好处之一是极便宜的抗量子签名。
summary.en: Introduces EIP-8288 (recursive STARK mempools), hoped for the fork after Hegotá; one benefit is very cheap post-quantum signatures.

summary.zh: 基金会协议组发布优先事项，以「2029 年 12 月前让以太坊 L1 抗量子」为锚。
summary.en: The Protocol Cluster published its priorities, anchored on a quantum-resistant Ethereum L1 by December 2029.

migration.en: Ethereum's post-quantum plan moves accounts to post-quantum signatures through account abstraction and signature-verification precompiles; no activation date is set.
migration.zh: 以太坊的抗量子计划是通过账户抽象和签名验证预编译，让账户改用抗量子签名；还没有定启用日期。

exposure.figure: 20.5 million ETH in the 1,000 largest accounts
exposure.figure_zh: 余额最大的 1,000 个账户里有 2,050 万枚 ETH
exposure.en: Babbush et al. (arXiv 2603.28846, March 2026) count the ETH with an exposed public key among the 1,000 largest accounts at the time of writing (section V.1). It covers only those accounts, so the total is higher (this site's summary).
exposure.zh: Babbush 等（arXiv 2603.28846，2026 年 3 月）统计了写作时余额最大的 1,000 个账户里公钥已暴露的 ETH（第 V.1 节）。只统计了这些账户，所以总数更高（这一句是本站的概括）。
exposure.publisher: Google Quantum AI (Babbush et al.), arXiv 2603.28846

stage_basis.en: BNB Chain has published a migration study, and its post-quantum proposals BEP-713 and BEP-736 are still open pull requests. Nothing is merged.
stage_basis.zh: BNB Chain 发布了迁移研究，抗量子提案 BEP-713 和 BEP-736 仍是未合并的拉取请求。

holder_can_use_today.en: There is no post-quantum option at the protocol level.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 协议层没有抗量子选项。

note.en: The report does not say whether the tests ran on a private testbed or a public network, and no post-quantum feature is on BSC testnet or mainnet. BEP-575, 707, 708, 713, 726 and 736 are all open pull requests or Drafts in bnb-chain/BEPs; none is merged.
note.zh: 测试报告没有说明测试是在私有环境还是公开网络上进行；BSC 的测试网和主网上都没有抗量子功能。BEP-575、707、708、713、726 和 736 在 bnb-chain/BEPs 中都是未合并的拉取请求或草案。

latest_step.text: BEP-736 (ML-DSA-44 and SLH-DSA verification precompiles) opened as a pull request. The migration roadmap BEP-713 is still unmerged.
latest_step.zh: BEP-736（ML-DSA-44 和 SLH-DSA 验签预编译）已提交，尚未合并；迁移路线图 BEP-713 也未合并。

milestones.name: BSC post-quantum migration report: a test build signs transactions with ML-DSA-44 and aggregates validator votes with a STARK proof (pqSTARK); cross-region transfer throughput fell from 4,973 to 2,997 TPS in tests.
milestones.zh: BSC 抗量子迁移报告：测试版本用 ML-DSA-44 签交易，用 STARK 证明（pqSTARK）聚合验证者投票；测试中跨地区转账吞吐量从 4,973 TPS 降到 2,997 TPS。

milestones.name: Proof-of-concept pull request bsc #3660 (ML-DSA-44 transactions, STARK-aggregated votes), opened 2026-04-28 and closed without merging on 2026-05-11.
milestones.zh: 概念验证拉取请求 bsc #3660（ML-DSA-44 交易签名，STARK 聚合投票），2026-04-28 提交，2026-05-11 未合并即关闭。

milestones.name: BEP-713 Post-Quantum Cryptography Migration Roadmap for BSC (Information; four phases)
milestones.zh: BEP-713 BSC 抗量子密码迁移路线图（信息类，分四个阶段）

milestones.name: BEP-736 Post-Quantum Signature Verification Precompiles
milestones.zh: BEP-736 抗量子签名验证预编译

stage_basis.en: Ripple has published a post-quantum roadmap, and a Dilithium key type is merged only into rippled's experimental alphanet branch, not into a release.
stage_basis.zh: Ripple 发布了抗量子路线图；Dilithium 密钥类型只合并进 rippled 的实验分支 alphanet，没有进入正式版本。

holder_can_use_today.en: There is no post-quantum option on mainnet.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 主网上没有抗量子选项。

note.en: No post-quantum XLS proposal from the core developers exists in XRPLF/XRPL-Standards as of the check date.
note.zh: 截至核对日，XRPLF/XRPL-Standards 中没有核心开发者提出的抗量子 XLS 提案。

latest_step.text: An ML-DSA (Dilithium) key type was merged into the experimental 'alphanet' branch of rippled. It is not in the main development branch, and there is no XLS standard for it.
latest_step.zh: ML-DSA（Dilithium）密钥类型已合并进 rippled 的实验分支 alphanet，未进入主开发分支，也没有对应的 XLS 标准。

milestones.name: Ripple's four-phase post-quantum roadmap; Phase 4 (native post-quantum signatures via a new amendment) targets 2028
milestones.zh: Ripple 的四阶段抗量子路线图；第 4 阶段（通过新修正案引入原生抗量子签名）目标为 2028 年

status.en: Roadmap from Ripple (a company), target not rated
status.zh: Ripple 公司的路线图，目标不参与评档

milestones.name: Dilithium key type merged into the 'alphanet' branch of XRPLF/rippled
milestones.zh: Dilithium 密钥类型合并进 XRPLF/rippled 的 alphanet 分支

status.en: Prototype code on an experimental branch
status.zh: 实验分支上的原型代码

claim.en: AlphaNet, a public developer network, runs quantum accounts and transactions with ML-DSA.
claim.zh: 公开开发者网络 AlphaNet 正在运行使用 ML-DSA 的量子账户和交易。

reason.en: AlphaNet is not listed in the official XRPL documentation, and the endpoints we found are run by a third party. The code exists on a branch, but we could not confirm who operates the network or what it runs.
reason.zh: 官方 XRPL 文档中没有 AlphaNet，我们找到的接入点由第三方运营。代码确实在分支上，但无法确认网络由谁运营、运行的是什么。

relation.zh: XRP Ledger 基金会官方号

summary.zh: 基金会 CTO 在 CoinDesk 直播中说，XRP Ledger 在量子准备上「领先且准备充分」。
summary.en: The foundation's CTO said on CoinDesk that the XRP Ledger is "ahead of the game and well prepared" for quantum readiness.

stage_basis.en: Anza's Falcon implementation is an open draft pull request in solana-sdk, and the Falcon syscall proposal SIMD-0461 was closed without merge.
stage_basis.zh: Anza 的 Falcon 实现在 solana-sdk 中仍是未合并的草案拉取请求；Falcon 系统调用提案 SIMD-0461 已关闭，未合并。

algo.zh: Falcon（提案已关闭）；哈希方案（研究中）

holder_can_use_today.en: Nothing at the protocol level. Third-party open-source vault code that locks SOL behind hash-based one-time signatures exists (blueshift-gg/solana-winternitz-vault); it is not a Solana feature and is not counted.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 协议层暂无。有第三方开源的保险库代码，用基于哈希的一次性签名锁定 SOL，但这不是 Solana 的官方功能，不计入档位。

note.en: If the Project Eleven testnet is confirmed as a public Solana testnet with post-quantum accounts, Solana would move to stage 3.
note.zh: 如果 Project Eleven 的测试网被确认是支持抗量子账户的 Solana 公开测试网，Solana 将升至 3 档。

latest_step.text: Anza published Quantumglow, a research design for post-quantum consensus. The Falcon syscall proposal SIMD-0461 was closed without merge on 2026-06-17.
latest_step.zh: Anza 发布抗量子共识研究设计 Quantumglow。Falcon 验签提案 SIMD-0461 已于 2026 年 6 月 17 日关闭，未合并。

milestones.name: SIMD-0461 Falcon signature verification as a syscall
milestones.zh: SIMD-0461：以系统调用形式提供 Falcon 签名验证

milestones.name: Firedancer native Falcon verification (PR #9446); closed with the note that Falcon as an on-chain program is viable
milestones.zh: Firedancer 原生 Falcon 验证（PR #9446）；关闭时注明，Falcon 以链上程序形式实现是可行的

milestones.name: Anza Falcon implementation in solana-sdk (PR #537)
milestones.zh: Anza 在 solana-sdk 中的 Falcon 实现（PR #537）

milestones.name: Quantumglow: post-quantum version of Alpenglow consensus using a hash-based scheme
milestones.zh: Quantumglow：Alpenglow 共识的抗量子版本，采用基于哈希的方案

status.zh: 研究（没有 SIMD，也没有测试网）

milestones.name: Winternitz vault program (third party)
milestones.zh: Winternitz 保险库程序（第三方）

status.en: Open-source code; not a protocol feature; not counted
status.zh: 开源代码；不是协议功能，不计入档位

claim.en: Project Eleven, working with the Solana Foundation, deployed post-quantum signatures on a Solana testnet (December 2025).
claim.zh: Project Eleven 与 Solana 基金会合作，在一个 Solana 测试网上部署了抗量子签名（2025 年 12 月）。

reason.en: The Project Eleven and Solana Foundation pages blocked automated access, and press coverage says the signature scheme was not disclosed. We could not confirm that this is the public Solana testnet.
reason.zh: Project Eleven 和 Solana 基金会的页面拦截了自动访问，媒体报道称签名方案未公开。无法确认这就是 Solana 的公开测试网。

summary.zh: 官方号转介绍 Anza 研究员 7 月提出的 Quantumglow：Alpenglow 共识的抗量子改造方案（基于哈希签名），想在保护共识的同时保持快速终局；目前没有正式提案编号。
summary.en: Shares Quantumglow, proposed by Anza researchers in July: a post-quantum (hash-based) adaptation of the Alpenglow consensus that aims to keep fast finality. No SIMD number yet.

stage_basis.en: Falcon-512 is switched on in the Nile testnet by committee proposal 20628, so holders can sign with it there. The latest mainnet release has no post-quantum parameter.
stage_basis.zh: Nile 测试网经委员会第 20628 号提案启用了 Falcon-512，持币人可以在测试网上用它签名；最新主网版本没有抗量子参数。

algo.en: Falcon-512 on in testnet; ML-DSA-44 built, off
algo.zh: Falcon-512 已在测试网启用；ML-DSA-44 已实现，未启用

holder_can_use_today.en: Not on mainnet. On the Nile testnet, Falcon-512 signatures are switched on; ML-DSA-44 is implemented but not yet switched on.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 主网暂无。Nile 测试网已启用 Falcon-512 签名；ML-DSA-44 已实现，尚未启用。

note.en: Press reports of a Q3 2026 mainnet launch did not happen: the mainnet API shows no post-quantum parameter on the check date.
note.zh: 媒体所说的 2026 年第三季度上主网并未发生：核对当日，主网接口中没有抗量子参数。

today.en: Among the top 10 chains by market cap tracked here, TRON is the only one where holders can sign with a post-quantum key on an official public testnet: Falcon-512 is on in the Nile testnet.
today.zh: 在本站收录的市值前 10 条链里，TRON 是唯一能在官方公开测试网上用抗量子密钥签名的：Nile 测试网已启用 Falcon-512。

watch.en: The latest mainnet release has no post-quantum switch, and press reports of a Q3 2026 mainnet launch did not come true. TIP-899 is still a Draft.
watch.zh: 最新主网版本没有抗量子开关；媒体所说的 2026 年第三季度上主网并未发生。TIP-899 仍是草案。

can.en: Developers can try Falcon-512 accounts on the Nile testnet. Mainnet holders have no post-quantum option yet.
can.zh: 开发者可以在 Nile 测试网上试用 Falcon-512 账户。主网持币人目前没有抗量子选项。

next.en: The independent review that TIP-899's author called planned but not confirmed, then a mainnet governance proposal that switches Falcon-512 on.
next.zh: TIP-899 作者所说「已在计划中，但尚未确定」的独立审计，以及之后在主网启用 Falcon-512 的治理提案。

latest_step.text: TIP-899 is still Draft. Its author wrote that an independent review before activation is 'planned but not yet confirmed'. The latest mainnet release has no post-quantum switch.
latest_step.zh: TIP-899 仍是草案。作者表示，启用前的独立审计「已在计划中，但尚未确定」。最新主网版本没有抗量子开关。

milestones.name: TIP-899 Post-Quantum Signature Support (Falcon-512 and ML-DSA-44; off by default; each switched on by its own governance proposal). The issue was created 2026-07-01 UTC; its header says 2026-06-30.
milestones.zh: TIP-899 抗量子签名支持（Falcon-512 和 ML-DSA-44；默认关闭；各自需单独的治理提案开启）。议题创建于 2026-07-01（UTC），文中标头写的是 2026-06-30。

milestones.name: First Nile testnet build with post-quantum signatures (GreatVoyage-Nile-v4.8.2-PQ1-build1); latest PQ build v4.8.2.4-PQ1 on 2026-10-23
milestones.zh: 首个支持抗量子签名的 Nile 测试网版本（GreatVoyage-Nile-v4.8.2-PQ1-build1）；最新的 PQ 版本 v4.8.2.4-PQ1 于 2026-10-23 发布

milestones.name: Nile committee proposal 20628 sets ALLOW_FN_DSA_512 (parameter 1000 in the Nile code) to 1, switching Falcon-512 on; it was approved. No proposal has switched on ML-DSA-44 (parameter 1001). Proposal state read from a public Nile node on 2026-11-27.
milestones.zh: Nile 委员会第 20628 号提案把 ALLOW_FN_DSA_512（Nile 代码中的第 1000 号参数）设为 1，启用 Falcon-512，已获通过。ML-DSA-44（第 1001 号参数）还没有提案启用。提案状态于 2026-11-27 从公开的 Nile 节点读取。

milestones.name: The latest mainnet release, GreatVoyage-v4.8.2.4, has no post-quantum committee parameter: its parameter list ends at ALLOW_OPTIMIZE_TVM_STORAGE_KEY (102), so a Falcon-512 or ML-DSA-44 switch cannot yet be proposed on mainnet.
milestones.zh: 最新主网版本 GreatVoyage-v4.8.2.4 没有抗量子委员会参数：参数表止于 ALLOW_OPTIMIZE_TVM_STORAGE_KEY（第 102 号），所以主网还无法发起启用 Falcon-512 或 ML-DSA-44 的提案。

milestones.name: TIP-899's author writes that an independent review before activation is planned but not yet confirmed.
milestones.zh: TIP-899 作者表示，启用前的独立审计「已在计划中，但尚未确定」。

summary.zh: 孙宇晨在新加坡区块链周表示，预计波场会是最早抗量子的网络之一；端到端抗量子签名已在 Nile 测试网上线。
summary.en: At Singapore Blockchain Week, Justin Sun said TRON expects to be among the first quantum-resistant networks; end-to-end post-quantum signatures are live on the Nile testnet.

summary.zh: 波场的抗量子密码已在测试网上线，随时可以上主网。
summary.en: TRON's post-quantum cryptography is live on testnet and ready for mainnet at any time.

summary.zh: 宣布波场抗量子路线图公布。
summary.en: Announced that TRON's post-quantum roadmap has been published.

migration.en: On TRON's Nile testnet an account can add Falcon-512 signers and sign with them; mainnet has no post-quantum parameter switched on.
migration.zh: 在 TRON 的 Nile 测试网上，账户可以添加 Falcon-512 签名者并用它签名；主网没有启用任何抗量子参数。

audit.en: No audit yet: the TIP-899 author said in July 2026 that the third-party audit plan is not decided.
audit.zh: 还没有审计：TIP-899 作者 2026 年 7 月表示，第三方审计计划尚未确定。

stage_basis.en: No post-quantum research, roadmap or proposal appears in Hyperliquid's documentation or its GitHub organization.
stage_basis.zh: Hyperliquid 的官方文档和 GitHub 组织中，都没有抗量子研究、路线图或提案。

holder_can_use_today.en: Accounts are EVM wallets and actions are signed with EIP-712.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 账户是以太坊式钱包，操作用 EIP-712 签名。

note.en: A stage 0 rating reflects only what is public. It is not a judgement of the team's internal plans.
note.zh: 0 档只反映公开信息，不代表对团队内部计划的判断。

latest_step.text: No public post-quantum research or proposal. The full official documentation does not mention quantum, and the hyperliquid-dex GitHub organisation has no related issues or code.
latest_step.zh: 没有公开的抗量子研究或提案。官方文档全文未提及「量子」，GitHub 组织中也没有相关议题或代码。

milestones.name: Official documentation: no mention of quantum; signing uses EIP-712
milestones.zh: 官方文档：没有提到量子；签名使用 EIP-712

milestones.name: hyperliquid-dex GitHub organisation: no post-quantum issues or code
milestones.zh: hyperliquid-dex GitHub 组织：没有抗量子相关议题或代码

claim.en: A third-party vendor offers a Falcon-based vault for HYPE holders in early access.
claim.zh: 一家第三方厂商为 HYPE 持有人提供基于 Falcon 的保险库，目前处于抢先体验阶段。

reason.en: Vendor claim in press coverage only. Not reviewed, and it would not count as a chain feature.
reason.zh: 只有媒体转述的厂商说法，未经审查；即使属实，也不算链本身的功能。

note.en: No public node repository found
note.zh: 未找到公开的节点代码库

stage_basis.en: ZIP 2005 is Final and NU6.3 moved new shielded funds into the recoverable Ironwood pool on mainnet. The post-quantum Recovery Protocol is not specified yet, and recoverability alone tops out at stage 2.
stage_basis.zh: ZIP 2005 已定稿，NU6.3 已在主网把新的隐私资金转入可恢复的 Ironwood 池。抗量子恢复协议尚未制定，而「资金可恢复」最高只评 2 档。

algo.zh: 恢复协议，规范尚未写出

holder_can_use_today.en: Groundwork only. Since 2026-07-28, new shielded funds go into the Ironwood pool, whose notes are built so that a future post-quantum Recovery Protocol can return them. That protocol is not yet specified, so this is not post-quantum protection today. Funds left in the Sprout, Sapling or Orchard pools would not be recoverable.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 目前只是铺垫。自 2026 年 7 月 28 日起，新的隐私资金进入 Ironwood 池，待将来的抗量子「恢复协议」推出后可以恢复；该协议尚未写出规范，所以今天还不算保护。留在 Sprout、Sapling 或 Orchard 池中的资金将来无法恢复。

note.en: Zcash's quantum-related consensus change is live on mainnet, but it is capped at stage 2 because recoverability is not a post-quantum way to spend. The 2026-07-28 activation date is the timestamp of block 3,428,143 on a public block explorer.
note.zh: Zcash 的量子相关共识改动已在主网上线，但由于「可恢复」并不是抗量子的转账方式，最高只评 2 档。2026-07-28 这个激活日期，取自公开区块浏览器上第 3,428,143 号区块的时间戳。

latest_step.text: The NU6.3 network upgrade activated on mainnet at block 3,428,143, bringing in ZIP 2005 (Ironwood quantum recoverability). The wallet migration guide, ZIP 318, is still Draft.
latest_step.zh: NU6.3 网络升级在第 3,428,143 号区块激活，带来 ZIP 2005（Ironwood 量子可恢复性）。钱包迁移指南 ZIP 318 仍是草案。

milestones.name: ZIP 2005 Ironwood Quantum Recoverability ('does not by itself make the protocol secure against quantum adversaries')
milestones.zh: ZIP 2005 Ironwood 量子可恢复性（原文称其「本身并不能让协议抵御量子攻击者」）

milestones.name: ZIP 258 NU6.3 deployment: mainnet activation height 3,428,143; after activation no new value may enter the Orchard pool, so new shielded value goes to Ironwood
milestones.zh: ZIP 258 NU6.3 部署：主网激活高度 3,428,143；激活后新资金不能再进入 Orchard 池，新的隐私资金改为进入 Ironwood 池

milestones.name: ZIP 318 Orchard to Ironwood Migration (wallet best practices)
milestones.zh: ZIP 318 从 Orchard 迁移到 Ironwood（钱包最佳实践）

milestones.name: Recovery Protocol (the actual post-quantum spend path)
milestones.zh: 恢复协议（真正的抗量子转账路径）

status.zh: ZIP 2005 中有概述，尚未写出规范

summary.zh: Ironwood 升级为 Zcash 引入了「量子可恢复」的隐私票据；ZIP 2005 为此预留了一个域分隔符。
summary.en: The Ironwood upgrade introduced quantum-recoverable shielded notes; ZIP 2005 reserves a domain separator for it.

migration.en: Zcash puts new shielded funds in the Ironwood pool, and older Sapling or Orchard funds are meant to move there; the Recovery Protocol that would use it is not specified yet.
migration.zh: Zcash 把新的屏蔽资金放进 Ironwood 池，较早的 Sapling 或 Orchard 资金需要迁到那里；会用到它的恢复协议还没有写成规范。

stage_basis.en: Falcon-512 and Dilithium2 exist only in the libdogecoin library and in a draft proposal without a number. Nothing is in Dogecoin Core.
stage_basis.zh: Falcon-512 和 Dilithium2 只存在于 libdogecoin 库和一份没有编号的草案提案中，Dogecoin Core 里没有。

consensus.zh: 工作量证明（与莱特币合并挖矿）

holder_can_use_today.en: Nothing that protects funds. The experimental post-quantum 'commitments' written into OP_RETURN outputs are consensus-neutral by design, so coins are still spent with ECDSA alone.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 没有能保护资金的功能。写入 OP_RETURN 的实验性抗量子「承诺」按设计不改变共识，币仍只靠 ECDSA 签名保护。

note.en: The draft states it 'can be adapted to a DIP process if/when a formal DIP track is preferred'. Until it enters the dogecoin/dips track, it counts as a proposal (stage 1), not a merged spec.
note.zh: 草案称，如果日后更倾向于走正式的 DIP 流程，它「可以改写为 DIP」。在进入 dogecoin/dips 之前，它只算提案（1 档），不算已合并的规范。

latest_step.text: The Dogecoin Foundation's libdogecoin library merged further post-quantum tooling (liboqs linking and tests). Nothing has reached Dogecoin Core or a DIP.
latest_step.zh: 狗狗币基金会的 libdogecoin 库又合并了一批抗量子工具（liboqs 链接和测试）。尚未进入 Dogecoin Core，也没有 DIP。

milestones.name: Draft proposal 'Post-Quantum Signature Commitments' (Phase 1: OP_RETURN commitments, no consensus change; later: a soft-fork opcode); added to libdogecoin in PR #288
milestones.zh: 草案提案「抗量子签名承诺」（第 1 阶段：写入 OP_RETURN 的承诺，不改共识；之后：软分叉操作码），经 PR #288 加入 libdogecoin

status.en: Draft, no BIP or DIP number; lives in a library repository, not the formal DIP track
status.zh: 草案，没有 BIP 或 DIP 编号；存放在工具库中，不在正式 DIP 流程里

milestones.name: liboqs-based Falcon-512 and Dilithium2 support in libdogecoin (library layer; Raccoon-G added in PR #294)
milestones.zh: libdogecoin 基于 liboqs 支持 Falcon-512 和 Dilithium2（工具库层面；PR #294 加入 Raccoon-G）

status.en: Merged into the library, not into Dogecoin Core
status.zh: 已合并进工具库，未进入 Dogecoin Core

milestones.name: libdogecoin PR #294 merged: post-quantum carrier support and Raccoon-G, a lattice-based signature that is not a NIST scheme. Library layer only, not Dogecoin Core.
milestones.zh: libdogecoin 合并 PR #294：抗量子载体支持和 Raccoon-G（格密码签名，不是 NIST 方案）。只在工具库层面，不在 Dogecoin Core 里。

status.en: Merged into the library; not in Dogecoin Core
status.zh: 已合并进工具库；不在 Dogecoin Core 里

claim.en: The Dogecoin Foundation confirmed an experimental post-quantum transaction on mainnet (April 2026).
claim.zh: 狗狗币基金会确认在主网上完成了一笔实验性的抗量子交易（2026 年 4 月）。

reason.en: We did not retrieve the Foundation's own announcement. Either way, the draft describes such transactions as consensus-neutral, so they would not change the stage.
reason.zh: 没有拿到基金会的原始公告。无论是否属实，草案都把这类交易定为不改变共识，不影响档位。

stage_basis.en: Post-quantum signatures are an open research topic in the Monero Research Lab (issue #159). There is no proposal or code for spending.
stage_basis.zh: 抗量子签名在 Monero 研究实验室仍是开放的研究议题（#159），还没有针对花费的提案或代码。

holder_can_use_today.en: There is no post-quantum option at the protocol level.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 协议层没有抗量子选项。

note.en: Carrot's quantum-related property concerns privacy (who paid whom), not protection of funds from theft, so it does not count toward the stage.
note.zh: Carrot 与量子相关的特性关乎隐私（谁付钱给谁），不涉及防止资金被盗，因此不计入档位。

latest_step.text: The Monero Research Lab opened a discussion on post-quantum spend signatures. The next upgrade (FCMP++ with Carrot addressing) adds some privacy protection against quantum observers but keeps elliptic-curve spend signatures, and it is not on mainnet yet.
latest_step.zh: 门罗研究实验室开启了抗量子转账签名的讨论。下一次升级（FCMP++ 加 Carrot 地址）能在隐私层面防范部分量子观察者，但转账签名仍基于椭圆曲线，且尚未上线主网。

milestones.name: Monero Research Lab issue #159: post-quantum signatures (notes that FCMP++ still uses classical signatures for spend authorisation)
milestones.zh: 门罗研究实验室议题 #159：抗量子签名（指出 FCMP++ 的转账授权仍使用传统签名）

milestones.name: FCMP++/Carrot upgrade: mainnet hard-fork table still ends at version 16; latest release v0.18.5.4 (2026-10-17)
milestones.zh: FCMP++/Carrot 升级：主网硬分叉表仍止于第 16 版；最新版本 v0.18.5.4（2026-10-17）

stage_basis.en: Falcon-512 signature chains are available on mainnet as an opt-in. Classical Brainpool keys stay valid.
stage_basis.zh: 主网已可选用 Falcon-512 签名链，传统的 Brainpool 密钥仍然有效。

event.en: Tritium, the ledger version whose signature chains accept Falcon keys (signature type 0x01 in the release's code), started on mainnet with its first block.
event.zh: Tritium 账本版本在主网出了第一个区块；该版本代码中签名类型 0x01 即 Falcon，签名链可以使用 Falcon 密钥。

consensus.zh: 工作量证明 + 权益证明

holder_can_use_today.en: A holder can switch a signature chain to Falcon-512; classical Brainpool signatures stay valid.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 持币人可以把签名链换成 Falcon-512；传统 Brainpool 签名仍然有效。

note.en: Do not treat every Nexus account as post-quantum.
note.zh: 并非所有 Nexus 账户都抗量子。

latest_step.text: Node release 5.1.6 (DDoS limits, sync and API fixes). Its notes do not mention Falcon: Falcon-512 stays opt-in and Brainpool keys stay valid.
latest_step.zh: 节点发布 5.1.6（DDoS 限制、同步和 API 修复）。发布说明没有提到 Falcon：Falcon-512 仍需自行选用，Brainpool 密钥继续有效。

milestones.name: Experimental Falcon-512 key and signature code is added to the node (commit fca429fb).
milestones.zh: 节点代码加入实验性的 Falcon-512 密钥与签名（提交 fca429fb）。

milestones.name: Before Tritium launches, the default signature scheme is switched from Falcon to Brainpool (commit bb66d799).
milestones.zh: Tritium 上线前，默认签名方案由 Falcon 改为 Brainpool（提交 bb66d799）。

milestones.name: Tritium starts on mainnet. Signature chains carry a scheme type, Falcon-512 (0x01) or Brainpool (0x02); Brainpool is the default and Falcon is opt-in.
milestones.zh: Tritium 在主网启动。签名链带有方案类型：Falcon-512（0x01）或 Brainpool（0x02）；默认是 Brainpool，Falcon 需自行选用。

milestones.name: At release 5.1.6 the node still defines the Falcon signature type next to Brainpool and secp256k1, and implements Falcon-512 keys.
milestones.zh: 5.1.6 版本的节点代码仍在 Brainpool 和 secp256k1 之外定义 Falcon 签名类型，并实现 Falcon-512 密钥。

note.en: Commits are spread over two branches
note.zh: 提交分布在两个分支上

migration.en: A Nexus holder can switch a signature chain from Brainpool to Falcon-512 through the profile update command, so existing coins can move to a post-quantum key in place.
migration.zh: Nexus 持币人可以用 profile update 命令把签名链从 Brainpool 换成 Falcon-512，已有的币原地换上抗量子密钥。

audit.en: No independent audit of the Falcon-512 signature-chain code was found.
audit.zh: 没有找到对 Falcon-512 签名链代码的独立审计。

algo_note.en: Opt-in Falcon-512; classical Brainpool signatures remain valid. Signature chains commit to a subsequent key and scheme.
algo_note.zh: 可选用 Falcon-512；传统的 Brainpool 签名仍然有效。签名链会预先承诺下一把密钥及其方案。

stage_basis.en: Three Falcon-512 account classes are declared on Starknet mainnet, and a holder can deploy an account with one: two from the OpenZeppelin Contracts for Cairo v4.1.0-rc.0 pre-release (class hashes 0x014660ce… and 0x016111958d…) and one from S2morrow (0x37c7626b…), published by an individual developer (GitHub user feltroidprime). Every Starknet account is a contract, so an account class counts here (see the account-contract rule). None is published by the protocol or the Starknet Foundation, and none has a published audit.
stage_basis.zh: Starknet 主网上已声明 3 个 Falcon-512 账户类，持币人可以用其中之一部署账户：两个来自 OpenZeppelin Contracts for Cairo v4.1.0-rc.0 预发布版（class hash 0x014660ce… 和 0x016111958d…），一个来自 S2morrow（0x37c7626b…），由个人开发者（GitHub 用户 feltroidprime）发布。Starknet 的每个账户本身就是合约，所以账户类在这里计入档位（见「账户即合约」规则）。这些账户类都不是协议或 Starknet 基金会发布的，也都没有公开的审计报告。

algo.zh: Falcon-512 账户合约；STARK 证明

consensus.zh: 以太坊 L2 · 正逐步引入权益证明

holder_can_use_today.en: A holder can deploy an account from one of three Falcon-512 account classes declared on mainnet: two OpenZeppelin pre-release classes, or the S2morrow class by an individual developer. None is audited. Ordinary accounts use Stark-curve ECDSA. Starknet's validity proofs are STARKs, which rest on hash functions.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 持币人可以用主网上已声明的 3 个 Falcon-512 账户类之一部署账户：两个 OpenZeppelin 预发布版账户类，或由个人开发者发布的 S2morrow 账户类，都未经审计。普通账户使用 Stark 曲线 ECDSA。Starknet 的有效性证明是基于哈希函数的 STARK。

note.en: The Falcon account classes are pre-release or experimental, have no published audit, cost far more gas than ECDSA accounts, and existing accounts must move to them one by one. Ethereum settlement and bridge dependencies remain.
note.zh: 这些 Falcon 账户类是预发布版或实验性的，没有公开的审计报告，手续费远高于 ECDSA 账户，现有账户要逐个迁移过去。以太坊结算和跨链桥的依赖仍在。

latest_step.text: OpenZeppelin Contracts for Cairo v4.1.0-rc.0, a pre-release, adds Falcon-512 accounts. None of the three Falcon account classes has a published audit.
latest_step.zh: OpenZeppelin Contracts for Cairo v4.1.0-rc.0（预发布版）加入 Falcon-512 账户。三个 Falcon 账户类都没有公开的审计报告。

milestones.name: OpenZeppelin Contracts for Cairo v4.1.0-rc.0, a pre-release, adds Falcon-512 account components and presets. Falcon is verified in Cairo contract code, not by a protocol builtin.
milestones.zh: OpenZeppelin Contracts for Cairo 预发布版 v4.1.0-rc.0 加入 Falcon-512 账户组件和预设。Falcon 验签写在 Cairo 合约代码里，不是协议内置功能。

milestones.name: starknet.js (the starknet-io SDK) lists the class hashes of three Falcon-512 accounts declared on mainnet: OpenZeppelin hint (0x014660ce…), OpenZeppelin direct (0x016111958d…) and S2morrow (0x37c7626b…).
milestones.zh: starknet.js（starknet-io 的 SDK）列出主网上已声明的 3 个 Falcon-512 账户类的 class hash：OpenZeppelin hint（0x014660ce…）、OpenZeppelin direct（0x016111958d…）和 S2morrow（0x37c7626b…）。

milestones.name: S2morrow Falcon-512 account contract, published by GitHub user feltroidprime (a fork of starkware-bitcoin/s2morrow). No audit is published.
milestones.zh: S2morrow Falcon-512 账户合约，由 GitHub 用户 feltroidprime 发布（复刻自 starkware-bitcoin/s2morrow），没有公开的审计报告。

summary.zh: 公开挑战赛把 Falcon-512 验签成本压到每笔约 0.023 美元。
summary.en: In an open challenge, Falcon-512 verification reached about $0.023 per transaction.

summary.zh: 93.5% 的投票同意研究让 Starknet 成为独立的抗量子 L1。
summary.en: 93.5% voted to research Starknet becoming an independent post-quantum L1.

summary.zh: 正在考虑转为 L1，目标是 2027 年成为第一个完全抗量子的网络。
summary.en: Actively considering becoming an L1, with 2027 as the target to become the first fully quantum-resistant network.

migration.en: A Starknet holder can deploy an account from one of three Falcon-512 account classes declared on mainnet and send funds to it. None of the three is audited, and one is a pre-release.
migration.zh: Starknet 持币人可以用主网上已声明的三个 Falcon-512 账户类之一部署账户，再把资金转过去；这三个都没有经过审计，其中一个还是预发布版本。

audit.en: No independent audit of the Falcon-512 account classes was found; OpenZeppelin's verifier repository calls itself experimental and unaudited.
audit.zh: 没有找到对 Falcon-512 账户类的独立审计；OpenZeppelin 的验证器仓库自己写明是实验性的、未经审计。

stage_basis.en: Since consensus version 42, mainnet accepts native Falcon-1024 accounts: a holder can rekey to a Falcon address and sign with Falcon. Ordinary Ed25519 accounts remain the default.
stage_basis.zh: 自共识版本 42 起，主网接受原生 Falcon-1024 账户：持币人可以把账户换绑到 Falcon 地址并用 Falcon 签名。普通 Ed25519 账户仍是默认。

event.en: Mainnet moved to consensus version 42, which enables Falcon-1024 accounts, at block 64,318,659.
event.zh: 主网在第 64,318,659 个区块切换到共识版本 42，启用 Falcon-1024 账户。

algo.en: Falcon-1024 accounts (deterministic variant, opt-in); Falcon State Proofs
algo.zh: Falcon-1024 账户（确定性变体，可自选）；Falcon 状态证明

holder_can_use_today.en: Native Falcon-1024 accounts are live on mainnet as an opt-in (since consensus version 42), and Falcon also signs State Proofs. Ordinary Ed25519 accounts remain the default.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 主网已上线原生 Falcon-1024 账户，可自选（自共识版本 42 起）；Falcon 也用于签署状态证明。普通 Ed25519 账户仍是默认。

note.en: State Proofs and account signing have different roles. Consensus participation keys remain classical; app and wallet support still matters.
note.zh: 状态证明和账户签名是两回事。共识参与密钥仍使用传统算法；还需要钱包和应用支持。

latest_step.text: go-algorand v5.1.1 adds Falcon-512 next to Falcon-1024 and a post-quantum LogicSig scheme. No protocol upgrade yet.
latest_step.zh: go-algorand v5.1.1 在 Falcon-1024 之外新增 Falcon-512，以及用于 LogicSig 的抗量子方案。尚未包含协议升级。

milestones.name: go-algorand v5.0.0 adds consensus version 42, which turns on native Falcon-1024 accounts (EnablePQSchemeFalcon1024).
milestones.zh: go-algorand v5.0.0 加入共识版本 42，启用原生 Falcon-1024 账户（EnablePQSchemeFalcon1024）。

milestones.name: Mainnet moves to consensus version 42 at block 64,318,659, enabling Falcon-1024 accounts. Mainnet now runs version 43, which keeps them.
milestones.zh: 主网在第 64,318,659 号区块切换到共识版本 42，启用 Falcon-1024 账户。主网现在运行的版本 43 沿用了这项功能。

summary.zh: Algorand 主网上用抗量子签名签署的交易已达 400 万笔。
summary.en: 4 million transactions on Algorand mainnet have now been signed with post-quantum signatures.

summary.zh: Algorand 从 2022 年起在生产环境用抗量子密码，原生抗量子账户已在主网上线。
summary.en: Algorand has run post-quantum cryptography in production since 2022, with native post-quantum accounts live on mainnet.

summary.zh: 提醒节点升级到 algod v5.1.1，这一版为抗量子账户打下更多基础。
summary.en: Asked node runners to upgrade to algod v5.1.1, which expands the foundation for post-quantum accounts.

migration.en: Since mainnet moved to consensus version 42 (block 64,318,659), the protocol authorizes transactions signed with Falcon-1024, so a holder can move ALGO to a Falcon-1024 account.
migration.zh: 主网在第 64,318,659 个区块切换到共识版本 42 后，协议接受 Falcon-1024 签名的交易，持币人可以把 ALGO 转到 Falcon-1024 账户。

audit.en: No independent audit of the Falcon-1024 account code was found.
audit.zh: 没有找到对 Falcon-1024 账户代码的独立审计。

stage_basis.en: A SPHINCS+ lock script is deployed on mainnet. Holders opt in by moving coins into it.
stage_basis.zh: SPHINCS+ 锁定脚本已部署在主网上，持币人把币转入即可选用。

event.en: The SPHINCS+ lock script was deployed on mainnet in block 18,363,853.
event.zh: SPHINCS+ 锁定脚本在第 18,363,853 个区块部署到主网。

algo.en: SLH-DSA (FIPS 205) lock script covering all 12 parameter sets (opt-in)
algo.zh: SLH-DSA（FIPS 205）锁定脚本，覆盖全部 12 个参数集（可选）

holder_can_use_today.en: A holder can move CKB into a cell locked by the SPHINCS+ lock script deployed on mainnet.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 持币人可以把 CKB 转进由主网已部署的 SPHINCS+ 锁定脚本锁定的 cell。

note.en: Existing cells must satisfy their old spending rules before migration. Default secp256k1 cells do not change automatically.
note.zh: 已有的 cell 必须先按原规则转出才能迁移；默认使用 secp256k1 的 cell 不会自动切换。

latest_step.text: SPHINCS+ lock script deployed on mainnet in block 18,363,853. Existing coins must be moved into a cell it locks to use it.
latest_step.zh: SPHINCS+ 锁定脚本在主网第 18,363,853 号区块部署。已有的币要转入由它锁定的 cell 才能使用。

milestones.name: ScaleBit publishes its final audit report of the quantum-resistant lock script (dated 2025-11-21 on its cover).
milestones.zh: ScaleBit 发布抗量子锁定脚本的最终审计报告（封面日期 2025-11-21）。

milestones.name: The SPHINCS+ lock script, one script covering all 12 FIPS 205 parameter sets, is deployed on mainnet in block 18,363,853 (transaction 0x4598d00d…f500a).
milestones.zh: SPHINCS+ 锁定脚本在主网第 18,363,853 号区块部署（交易 0x4598d00d…f500a），一个脚本覆盖 FIPS 205 全部 12 套参数。

summary.zh: CKB 不用分叉就已经上线了 SPHINCS+。
summary.en: CKB already has SPHINCS+ live without a protocol fork.

migration.en: A CKB holder can move coins into cells locked by the SPHINCS+ lock script deployed on mainnet in January 2026.
migration.zh: CKB 持币人可以把币转进由 SPHINCS+ 锁定脚本锁定的 cell，这个脚本 2026 年 1 月已部署到主网。

audit.en: ScaleBit audited the lock script (one minor finding, acknowledged). The SPHINCS+ library underneath is not in the audited file list, so the audit is partial.
audit.zh: ScaleBit 审计了锁定脚本（一项轻微问题，项目方已确认）。底层 SPHINCS+ 库不在审计文件清单里，所以算部分审计。

algo_note.en: An opt-in SPHINCS+ spending lock. New verification logic can be deployed as lock scripts.
algo_note.zh: 可选用的 SPHINCS+ 锁定脚本。新的验签逻辑可以作为锁定脚本部署。

stage_basis.en: Every mainnet transfer is signed with multivariate Rainbow or UOV keys by default. New keys default to configuration 274 (RAINBOW16_72_8_48); as of 2026-11-27 this site found no public analysis of that parameter set. The public node code still accepts the legacy configuration 0, Rainbow(16,32,32,32), at any block height, and a published method recovers private keys made with those parameters (shown in 2022 by Kannwischer and Panny).
stage_basis.zh: 主网每笔转账默认使用多变量 Rainbow 或 UOV 密钥签名。新密钥默认用配置 274（RAINBOW16_72_8_48）；截至 2026-11-27，本站没有找到针对这组参数的公开分析。公开的节点代码在任何区块高度都仍接受旧配置 0，即 Rainbow（16,32,32,32）；用这组参数生成的密钥，私钥可以用已公开的方法恢复（Kannwischer 与 Panny 2022 年演示过）。

event.en: Genesis block timestamp, fixed in the node's source code.
event.zh: 创世区块时间戳写在节点源代码里。

holder_can_use_today.en: Every address signs with Rainbow or UOV keys. New keys default to configuration 274, which has no public analysis. The public node code still accepts the legacy configuration 0, Rainbow(16,32,32,32), whose private keys can be recovered with a published method; whether the official abcmint client's prebuilt signing library does the same was not checked.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 每个地址都用 Rainbow 或 UOV 密钥签名。新密钥默认用配置 274，目前没有公开分析。公开的节点代码仍接受旧配置 0，即 Rainbow（16,32,32,32），这组参数的私钥可以用已公开的方法恢复；官方 abcmint 客户端预编译的签名库是否同样接受，未核实。

note.en: The guide lists Rainbow configuration 274 (RAINBOW16_72_8_48) as the default; no public analysis of it was found. The public node code (src/key.cpp) still verifies the legacy configuration 0, Rainbow(16,32,32,32), with no block-height condition; the official abcmint client's signing library is prebuilt, and whether it does the same was not checked. In 2022 Kannwischer and Panny recovered the private key of a legacy ABCMint address that used those parameters. NIST UOV candidate parameters are not Raqcoin deployment parameters.
note.zh: 使用指南将 Rainbow 配置 274（RAINBOW16_72_8_48）列为默认，没有找到针对它的公开分析。公开的节点代码（src/key.cpp）验证旧配置 0，即 Rainbow（16,32,32,32）时没有任何区块高度条件；官方 abcmint 客户端的签名库是预编译的，是否同样接受未核实。2022 年 Kannwischer 与 Panny 恢复出一个使用这组参数的旧版 ABCMint 地址的私钥。NIST 的 UOV 候选参数并非 Raqcoin 的实际部署参数。

latest_step.text: Last commit to the community client repository. The original repository last changed 2025-10-13.
latest_step.zh: 社区客户端代码库的最后一次提交。原始代码库最后一次改动在 2025-10-13。

milestones.name: Mainnet genesis block (ABCMint codebase; timestamp fixed in the node's source code). Every transfer is signed with Rainbow.
milestones.zh: 主网创世区块（ABCMint 代码库，时间戳写在节点源代码里）。每笔转账都用 Rainbow 签名。

milestones.name: Kannwischer and Panny forge a signature for a legacy ABCMint address by recovering its Rainbow(16,32,32,32) private key with Beullens' attack.
milestones.zh: Kannwischer 与 Panny 用 Beullens 的攻击方法恢复出一个旧版 ABCMint 地址的 Rainbow（16,32,32,32） 私钥，并伪造了签名。

milestones.name: The public node code (RAQ-coin/Raqcoin main at 160790d5) verifies the legacy configuration 0, Rainbow(16,32,32,32), at any block height; the fork height 267120 only opens the newer configurations.
milestones.zh: 公开的节点代码（RAQ-coin/Raqcoin main 分支 160790d5）在任何区块高度都验证旧配置 0，即 Rainbow（16,32,32,32）；分叉高度 267120 只是放行新配置。

migration.en: Raqcoin addresses have signed with Rainbow multivariate signatures since the 2018 genesis, so there are no classical-key coins to move. Keys made with the legacy Rainbow(16,32,32,32) parameters can have their private keys recovered with a published method, and the public node code still accepts them; that is a separate risk (see Algorithm).
migration.zh: 自 2018 年创世起，Raqcoin 的每个地址都用 Rainbow 多变量签名，没有传统密钥下的币需要迁移。用旧参数 Rainbow（16,32,32,32）生成的密钥，私钥可以用已公开的方法恢复，而公开的节点代码仍接受这组参数；这是另一项风险，见「算法」。

audit.en: No independent audit of the Rainbow signature code was found; the abcmint repository has no audit report.
audit.zh: 没有找到对 Rainbow 签名代码的独立审计；abcmint 仓库里没有审计报告。

algo_note.en: RainbowPro and UOV configurations; multisig is a separate capability. Key configuration selects the signing scheme. Existing keys do not change automatically. A newly installed community client may fail to reach its built-in seed nodes (issue #9).
algo_note.zh: 可选 RainbowPro 和 UOV 配置；多签是另一项功能。签名方案由密钥配置决定，已有密钥不会自动更换。新装的社区客户端可能连不上内置种子节点（issue #9）。

stage_basis.en: Every mainnet transfer is signed with WOTS+ one-time signatures.
stage_basis.zh: 主网每笔转账都使用 WOTS+ 一次性签名。

event.en: Mainnet launch date given in the project's own wiki; every transfer is signed with WOTS+.
event.zh: 项目自己的 wiki 给出的主网上线日期；每笔转账都用 WOTS+ 签名。

holder_can_use_today.en: Every transfer is signed with a WOTS+ one-time signature.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 每笔转账都用 WOTS+ 一次性签名。

note.en: The switch to proof of stake rests on the project's website alone. The signing scheme remained WOTS+. No claim that a future protocol upgrade could never change it.
note.zh: 改为权益证明只有项目官网一处说法。签名方案仍是 WOTS+。这不代表未来的协议升级不会改变签名方案。

latest_step.text: Mochimo's website says the network now runs on proof of stake and mining has ended. It gives no switch date, and the node repository has no matching release. Signing stays WOTS+.
latest_step.zh: Mochimo 官网称网络已改为权益证明、挖矿已结束；没有给出切换日期，节点代码库也没有对应的发布。签名仍为 WOTS+。

milestones.name: Mainnet launches; every transfer is signed with WOTS+ one-time signatures.
milestones.zh: 主网上线，每笔转账都用 WOTS+ 一次性签名。

milestones.name: The website says Mochimo now runs on proof of stake and mining has ended; no date or block height is given.
milestones.zh: 官网称 Mochimo 已改为权益证明、挖矿已结束，没有给出日期或区块高度。

migration.en: Mochimo transfers have been signed with WOTS+ one-time signatures since the 2018 launch, so there are no classical-key coins to move.
migration.zh: 自 2018 年上线起，Mochimo 的转账都用 WOTS+ 一次性签名，没有传统密钥下的币需要迁移。

audit.en: No named independent audit report was found; the changelog mentions fixes from an unnamed audit.
audit.zh: 没有找到署名的独立审计报告；更新日志提到过一次未署名审计后的修复。

algo_note.en: WOTS+ transaction signatures. One active signing scheme in the reviewed material.
algo_note.zh: 交易使用 WOTS+ 签名。核查资料中只有这一种在用的签名方案。

stage_basis.en: Every QRL 1.x mainnet account has signed with XMSS since launch in June 2018.
stage_basis.zh: QRL 1.x 主网的所有账户自 2018 年 6 月上线起就使用 XMSS 签名。

event.en: Genesis block of the QRL mainnet; accounts sign with XMSS from the start.
event.zh: QRL 主网的创世区块；账户从一开始就用 XMSS 签名。

holder_can_use_today.en: XMSS transaction signatures. Hash-function choice and descriptor fields; not arbitrary switching between signature families.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 交易使用 XMSS 签名。可选择哈希函数并设置描述字段，但不能在不同签名族之间随意切换。

note.en: XMSS is stateful: each address can sign a limited number of times, and a one-time key index must never be reused.
note.zh: XMSS 是有状态签名：每个地址可签名的次数有限，一次性密钥序号不能重复使用。

today.en: Every QRL 1.x mainnet account signs with XMSS, a hash-based scheme, and has since launch in June 2018.
today.zh: QRL 1.x 主网的所有账户自 2018 年 6 月上线起，就使用基于哈希的 XMSS 签名。

watch.en: XMSS is stateful. Each address can sign a fixed number of times, and a one-time key index must never be used twice, so the wallet has to keep track.
watch.zh: XMSS 是有状态签名：每个地址可签名的次数固定，一次性密钥序号绝不能重复使用，钱包必须记录用到了哪一个。

can.en: Use a wallet that tracks the one-time key index, and check how many signatures your address has left before it runs out.
can.zh: 使用能记录一次性密钥序号的钱包，并在次数用完前查看地址还剩多少次签名。

next.en: QRL 2.0, which moves to NIST's ML-DSA and proof of stake. It is on Testnet V2, and the project says mainnet depends on audits and has no date.
next.zh: QRL 2.0 将改用 NIST 的 ML-DSA 和权益证明，目前处于测试网 V2。项目方表示主网上线取决于审计，尚未定日期。

latest_step.text: Node v4.0.13 keeps legacy XMSS compatibility and improves fork recovery.
latest_step.zh: 节点 v4.0.13 保留对旧版 XMSS 的兼容，并改进分叉恢复。

milestones.name: QRL mainnet launches. Every account signs with XMSS, a hash-based scheme.
milestones.zh: QRL 主网上线，所有账户都使用基于哈希的 XMSS 签名。

milestones.name: XMSS implementation in the QRL node, with a choice of hash functions (code pinned to a commit).
milestones.zh: QRL 节点中的 XMSS 实现，可选择哈希函数（代码固定到具体提交）。

milestones.name: QRL 2.0 public devnet pre-release.
milestones.zh: QRL 2.0 公开开发网预发布。

milestones.name: QRL 2.0 Testnet V1 goes live.
milestones.zh: QRL 2.0 测试网 V1 上线。

milestones.name: QRL 2.0 Testnet V2 launches as the audit-ready public testnet. QRL 2.0 signs transactions and validator duties with NIST's ML-DSA and moves to proof of stake.
milestones.zh: QRL 2.0 测试网 V2 上线，是一个已具备审计条件的公开测试网。QRL 2.0 的交易和验证者职责改用 NIST 的 ML-DSA 签名，共识改为权益证明。

milestones.name: Pull request #1824 merged: keeps legacy XMSS compatibility and makes fork recovery more robust.
milestones.zh: PR #1824 合并：保留对旧版 XMSS 的兼容，分叉恢复更稳健。

milestones.name: QRL node v4.0.13 released with that change.
milestones.zh: QRL 节点 v4.0.13 发布，包含上述改动。

milestones.name: QRL 2.0 mainnet: no date set. The project says launch depends on external audits.
milestones.zh: QRL 2.0 主网：尚未定日期。项目方表示，上线取决于外部审计结果。

milestones.name: Network check: QRL 1.x mainnet block #4,442,254 at 11:32 UTC.
milestones.zh: 网络核查：QRL 1.x 主网第 4,442,254 号区块，UTC 11:32 出块。

summary.zh: QRL 2.0 让 Solidity 开发者能在抗量子的链上开发。
summary.en: QRL 2.0 lets Solidity developers build on a post-quantum chain.

summary.zh: 发文分析：AI 会不会在量子计算机之前破解 ECDSA，ML-DSA 会不会是下一个。
summary.en: Shares an analysis of whether AI could break ECDSA before Q-Day, and whether ML-DSA could be next.

summary.zh: 核心团队今夏在新加坡集中开发 QRL 2.0。
summary.en: The core team met in Singapore this summer to build QRL 2.0.

migration.en: Every QRL 1.x account has signed with XMSS since the June 2018 launch, so there are no classical-key coins to move.
migration.zh: 自 2018 年 6 月创世起，QRL 1.x 的每个账户都用 XMSS 签名，没有传统密钥下的币需要迁移。

audit.en: X41 D-Sec reviewed the XMSS code in 2018. No later audit of the code the 1.x mainnet runs was found; newer audits cover QRL 2.0.
audit.zh: X41 D-Sec 在 2018 年审查过 XMSS 代码。没有找到对 1.x 主网现行代码的后续审计；较新的审计针对的是 QRL 2.0。

stage_basis.en: Falcon-512 signs every mainnet transfer.
stage_basis.zh: 主网每笔转账都使用 Falcon-512 签名。

event.en: Genesis block of the mainnet; transfers are signed with Falcon-512 from the start.
event.zh: 主网的创世区块；转账从一开始就用 Falcon-512 签名。

algo.en: Falcon-512; ML-DSA in upgrade code (not active)
algo.zh: Falcon-512；ML-DSA 已在升级代码中（未启用）

holder_can_use_today.en: Every transfer is signed with Falcon-512.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 每笔转账都用 Falcon-512 签名。

note.en: Implemented upgrade support does not establish that it is active on mainnet.
note.zh: 升级代码中已实现，不代表主网已启用。

latest_step.text: Release candidate 4 for Tidecoin 1.0.0 (pre-release) fixes wallet fee estimates. 1.0.0 final is not out.
latest_step.zh: Tidecoin 1.0.0 第四个候选版本（预发布）修复了钱包手续费估算问题，1.0.0 正式版尚未发布。

milestones.name: Mainnet starts; transfers are signed with Falcon-512 from the genesis block (README). The genesis block is on the explorer.
milestones.zh: 主网启动，从创世区块起转账就用 Falcon-512 签名（README）。创世区块可在区块浏览器上查到。

summary.zh: v1.0.0rc4 开放测试；主网合并挖矿仍未开启。
summary.en: v1.0.0rc4 is available for testing; merged mining on mainnet remains disabled.

summary.zh: v1.0.0rc1 开放测试：新的抗量子分层钱包、加密节点连接、合并挖矿支持（主网未开启）。
summary.en: v1.0.0rc1 is ready for testing: new post-quantum HD wallets, encrypted peer connections and merged-mining support (still disabled on mainnet).

summary.zh: 比较两条路线：把签名做小（Falcon-512，每笔约 1,563 字节），或用证明压缩大签名。
summary.en: Compares two routes: keep signatures small (Falcon-512, about 1,563 bytes per spend) or compress large ones with proofs.

migration.en: Tidecoin has signed every mainnet transfer with Falcon-512 since its 2020 genesis, so there are no classical-key coins to move.
migration.zh: 自 2020 年创世起，Tidecoin 主网每笔转账都用 Falcon-512 签名，没有传统密钥下的币需要迁移。

audit.en: No independent audit of the Falcon-512 code was found; the repository has a reporting policy and its own design notes only.
audit.zh: 没有找到对 Falcon-512 代码的独立审计；仓库里只有漏洞报告政策和项目自己的设计文档。

algo_note.en: Falcon-512 active; Falcon-1024 and ML-DSA exist in upgrade code. Multiple schemes are implemented behind an activation gate.
algo_note.zh: Falcon-512 已启用；Falcon-1024 和 ML-DSA 在升级代码中。多种方案已实现，但需达到激活条件才会启用。

stage_basis.en: Every mainnet transfer uses Abelian's lattice-based PQRingCT or PQRingCTX scheme.
stage_basis.zh: 主网每笔转账都使用 Abelian 自己的格密码方案 PQRingCT 或 PQRingCTX。

event.en: Genesis block time, fixed in the node's chain configuration.
event.zh: 创世区块时间写在节点的链配置里。

holder_can_use_today.en: Every transfer uses the project's own lattice-based scheme (PQRingCT).
holder_can_use_today.zh: 每笔转账都用项目自研的格密码方案（PQRingCT）。

note.en: These schemes are not ML-DSA. Dual PoW does not mean PoW plus PoS. QDay is a separate L2.
note.zh: 这些方案不是 ML-DSA。双工作量证明不等于 PoW 加 PoS。QDay 是单独的 L2。

latest_step.text: Aconcagua upgrade: dual proof of work (ABEL-ETHash and ABEL-Nakamoto). Signing unchanged.
latest_step.zh: Aconcagua 升级：改为双工作量证明（ABEL-ETHash 和 ABEL-Nakamoto），签名方案不变。

milestones.name: Mainnet genesis block (time fixed in the node's chain configuration).
milestones.zh: 主网创世区块（时间写在节点的链配置里）。

summary.zh: 主网从 2022 年第一天起，几乎所有交易都用格密码签名。
summary.en: Since day one in 2022, almost every mainnet transaction has been signed with lattice-based cryptography.

migration.en: Abelian has used its own lattice-based PQRingCT/PQRingCTX schemes for every transfer since the April 2022 genesis, so there are no classical-key coins to move.
migration.zh: 自 2022 年 4 月创世起，Abelian 每笔转账都用项目自研的格密码方案 PQRingCT / PQRingCTX，没有传统密钥下的币需要迁移。

audit.en: No independent audit report for the PQRingCT and PQRingCTX code was found.
audit.zh: 没有找到 PQRingCT 和 PQRingCTX 代码的独立审计报告。

algo_note.en: Custom lattice-based PQRingCT/PQRingCTX schemes. Versioned cryptographic schemes; mining algorithm choice is a separate matter.
algo_note.zh: 自研的格密码方案 PQRingCT/PQRingCTX。密码方案带版本号；挖矿算法的选择是另一回事。

stage_basis.en: The node creates Dilithium wallets by default (sig_dil in the wallet command), so native transfers are signed with a post-quantum scheme unless the holder picks another type. Whether the mainnet is running could not be checked independently: there is no public block API, scan.cellframe.net timed out on 2026-11-27, and the mainnet date rests on the project's own Telegram post.
stage_basis.zh: 节点默认创建 Dilithium 钱包（钱包命令中的 sig_dil），所以原生转账默认用抗量子签名，除非持币人另选签名类型。主网是否在运行未能独立核实：没有公开的出块接口，2026-11-27 访问 scan.cellframe.net 超时，主网日期只出自项目自己的 Telegram 帖子。

algo.en: Dilithium (the project's own variant, not ML-DSA; version not reviewed), Falcon, SPHINCS+ (wallet choice)
algo.zh: Dilithium（项目自己的变体，不是 ML-DSA，版本未经核实）、Falcon、SPHINCS+（钱包中可选）

consensus.zh: 权益证明 + 权威证明

holder_can_use_today.en: New wallets are Dilithium wallets, and every signing option the node offers is post-quantum.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 新钱包默认是 Dilithium 钱包，节点提供的所有签名选项都是抗量子的。

note.en: Scope is native CF-20 assets, not ERC-20/BEP-20 tokens. Picnic is a historical/deprecated route, not a current wallet option in this release. Shipovnik: the verifier flaw Fireblocks published on 2026-09-15 is still in the dap-sdk code, but the build files suggest current nodes do not compile Shipovnik in.
note.zh: 范围限于原生 CF-20 资产，不含 ERC-20/BEP-20 代币。Shipovnik：Fireblocks 于 2026-09-15 公布的验签漏洞仍在 dap-sdk 代码中，但从构建文件看，当前节点没有编译 Shipovnik。

latest_step.text: Last commit on the master branch of the public node mirror.
latest_step.zh: 公开节点镜像 master 分支的最后一次提交。

milestones.name: The node's wallet command creates a Dilithium wallet (sig_dil) unless another signature type is chosen; Falcon, SPHINCS+ and others are options.
milestones.zh: 节点的钱包命令默认创建 Dilithium 钱包（sig_dil），也可以另选 Falcon、SPHINCS+ 等签名类型。

claim.en: Cellframe mainnet is producing blocks today
claim.zh: Cellframe 主网今天仍在出块

reason.en: scan.cellframe.net and cellframe.net did not open from our checker on 2026-11-27; the code repositories were updated on 2026-11-26.
reason.zh: 2026-11-27 我们的核查环境打不开 scan.cellframe.net 和 cellframe.net；代码仓库 2026-11-26 仍有更新。

summary.zh: 团队眼下两件事：加固网络，并把 6.0 分支的主要功能移植到现在的 5.7 和即将发布的过渡版 5.8。
summary.en: The team is focused on hardening the network and backporting the main 6.0 features to the current 5.7 release and the imminent interim 5.8 release.

no_probe_reason.en: No public block API found; scan.cellframe.net timed out on 2026-11-27.
no_probe_reason.zh: 没有找到公开的出块接口；2026-11-27 访问 scan.cellframe.net 超时。

note.en: Releases are not published on GitHub
note.zh: 未在 GitHub 上发布版本

migration.en: The Cellframe node's current code creates Dilithium wallets by default, and every signing option (Dilithium, Falcon, SPHINCS+) is post-quantum, so there are no classical-key native coins to move. This rests on the current code, not on the code at genesis.
migration.zh: Cellframe 节点现行代码默认创建 Dilithium 钱包，可选的签名方案（Dilithium、Falcon、SPHINCS+）也都是抗量子的，所以没有传统密钥下的原生币需要迁移。这一点依据的是现行代码，不是创世时的代码。

event.en: The Backbone mainnet went live on new software; its wallets have signed with Dilithium by default since then.
event.zh: Backbone 主网换用新软件上线；此后钱包默认用 Dilithium 签名。

audit.en: CyStack audited the node and SDK in 2024 but left out the crypto folder, where the Dilithium, Falcon and SPHINCS+ code lives.
audit.zh: CyStack 在 2024 年审计了节点和 SDK，但没有包括存放 Dilithium、Falcon、SPHINCS+ 代码的加密目录。

algo_note.en: Native-wallet options include Dilithium, Falcon and SPHINCS+. Multiple native signing schemes, subject to network and wallet support.
algo_note.zh: 原生钱包可选 Dilithium、Falcon 和 SPHINCS+，能用哪种取决于网络和钱包。

stage_basis.en: Mainnet transfers use hybrid signatures. After block 3,426,263 the default is Ed25519 + ML-DSA, with an SLH-DSA public key embedded in the signature (compact mode).
stage_basis.zh: 主网转账使用混合签名。区块 3,426,263 之后，默认是 Ed25519 加 ML-DSA，签名里嵌入 SLH-DSA 公钥（紧凑模式）。

event.en: Genesis block of the mainnet; block 1 was mined the same day.
event.zh: 主网的创世区块；第 1 个区块在同一天挖出。

algo.en: Hybrid Ed25519 + ML-DSA, with an embedded SLH-DSA key
algo.zh: Ed25519 加 ML-DSA 混合签名，嵌入 SLH-DSA 公钥

holder_can_use_today.en: Every transfer carries a hybrid signature: Ed25519 plus ML-DSA, with an SLH-DSA key.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 每笔转账都带混合签名：Ed25519 加 ML-DSA，并带 SLH-DSA 公钥。

note.en: Do not assume every protocol phase uses exactly the same component combination. ML-KEM node handshakes are not transaction signatures. The pre-standard Dilithium and SPHINCS+ hybrid (with Ed25519) is still accepted, and was the default before block 3,426,263.
note.zh: 不同协议阶段的签名组合不一定相同。节点间的 ML-KEM 握手不是交易签名。标准化之前的 Dilithium 加 SPHINCS+ 混合签名（含 Ed25519）仍被接受，在区块 3,426,263 之前是默认方案。

latest_step.text: Tag test-v2.0.85 is the latest release and the latest commit in the main repository. As of 2026-11-27 the repository has 0 stars and no newer commits.
latest_step.zh: test-v2.0.85 标签是最新发布，也是主代码库的最后一次提交。截至 2026-11-27，主代码库 0 星，此后没有新提交。

milestones.name: From block 3,426,263 (produced 2026-02-03), validation uses the compact hybrid: Ed25519 + ML-DSA with an embedded SLH-DSA key (switch block set in defaults/config.go).
milestones.zh: 从区块 3,426,263（2026-02-03 产出）起，验证采用紧凑混合签名：Ed25519 加 ML-DSA，并嵌入 SLH-DSA 公钥（切换区块写在 defaults/config.go）。

milestones.name: Node release test-v2.0.85, the latest commit in the main repository.
milestones.zh: 节点发布 test-v2.0.85，也是主代码库的最后一次提交。

summary.zh: 转发一篇针对 NIST 第三轮格密码方案的新密码分析论文；称对 ML-DSA 没有直接影响，QuantumCoin 用的是混合签名方案。
summary.en: Shared new cryptanalysis of NIST third-round lattice schemes; says there is no immediate impact on ML-DSA and that QuantumCoin uses hybrid schemes.

summary.zh: 称 NIST 候选签名方案 SNOVA 已被攻破，攻击的第一版由 AI 系统发现。按论文（ePrint 2026/2154），攻破的是 6 组备选参数，推荐参数不受影响。
summary.en: Says SNOVA, a candidate in NIST's additional signature round, has been broken, with an AI system finding the first version of the attack. Per the paper (ePrint 2026/2154), the attack breaks six alternative parameter sets; the recommended sets are not affected.

migration.en: QuantumCoin has only ever signed with post-quantum hybrids (Ed25519 with Dilithium and SPHINCS+, now ML-DSA and SLH-DSA), so there are no classical-only coins; coins under the earlier pre-standard hybrid are still accepted.
migration.zh: QuantumCoin 只用过抗量子混合签名（先是 Ed25519 加 Dilithium 和 SPHINCS+，现在是 ML-DSA 和 SLH-DSA），没有只靠传统签名的币；早期标准发布前版本混合签名下的币仍然有效。

audit.en: No independent audit report for the hybrid signing code was found.
audit.zh: 没有找到混合签名代码的独立审计报告。

algo_note.en: Hybrid post-quantum and Ed25519 signing; ML-DSA and SLH-DSA components. Signing modes change at protocol thresholds and in emergency mode.
algo_note.zh: 抗量子签名与 Ed25519 混合签名，组件包括 ML-DSA 和 SLH-DSA。签名模式会在达到协议阈值时以及紧急模式下切换。

stage_basis.en: Mainnet spends are authorized by hash-preimage locks checked in STARK proofs, with no elliptic-curve signature. One address type ("elliptic curve hybrid") uses an elliptic-curve key to encrypt payment notifications, which affects privacy, not spending; generation addresses use a lattice-based scheme instead. A critical Triton VM proof-system bug was disclosed on 2026-01-21 and the network paused.
stage_basis.zh: 主网的花费由哈希原像锁授权，并在 STARK 证明中验证，不使用椭圆曲线签名。有一种地址类型（「椭圆曲线混合」地址）用椭圆曲线密钥加密付款通知，这影响隐私，不影响花费；generation 地址改用格密码方案。2026-01-21 公开了 Triton VM 证明系统的严重漏洞，网络曾暂停。

event.en: Genesis of the relaunched mainnet, after the first launch was halted by an inflation bug.
event.zh: 主网因通胀漏洞停摆后重新启动，这是重启后主网的创世时间。

holder_can_use_today.en: Coins are spent with hash-based locks checked in STARK proofs; no elliptic-curve signature is involved.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 花费币靠哈希锁，并在 STARK 证明中验证，不涉及椭圆曲线签名。

note.en: A STARK proof and a hash-preimage spending condition are not a fixed-size standard digital signature.
note.zh: STARK 证明和哈希原像支出条件，都不是固定长度的标准数字签名。

latest_step.text: neptune-core v0.20.1 (build fix only).
latest_step.zh: neptune-core v0.20.1（仅修复构建）。

milestones.name: An inflation bug is found; the team announces it the next day and decides to restart the chain from a new genesis block with a snapshot of balances at block 21,310.
milestones.zh: 发现增发漏洞；团队次日公告，决定用新的创世区块重启主网，并带上第 21,310 号区块时的余额快照。

milestones.name: Mainnet relaunches at about 19:00 UTC from a new genesis block, after about a month of downtime.
milestones.zh: 停摆约一个月后，主网在 UTC 19:00 左右从新的创世区块重新启动。

milestones.name: Genesis parameters for the relaunch are committed to neptune-core.
milestones.zh: neptune-core 提交重启用的创世参数。

milestones.name: A critical vulnerability in the Triton VM proof system is disclosed and the network pauses.
milestones.zh: Triton VM 证明系统的严重漏洞公开，网络暂停。

milestones.name: neptune-core v0.6.0 resumes the network, rolled back to block 23,400.
milestones.zh: neptune-core v0.6.0 恢复网络，回滚到第 23,400 号区块。

claim.en: The relaunched mainnet is producing blocks.
claim.zh: 重启后的主网在正常出块。

reason.en: No public block API was reachable (explorer.neptune.cash returned HTTP 502 on 2026-11-27), so block height and timing could not be checked.
reason.zh: 没有可用的公开出块接口（2026-11-27 访问 explorer.neptune.cash 返回 HTTP 502），所以无法核对区块高度和出块时间。

summary.zh: 软分叉 epsilon 并入主代码：从 62,500 号区块起，每个新区块都证明前一个区块有效。
summary.en: Softfork epsilon is merged: from block 62,500, every new block proves the one before it is valid.

summary.zh: 发布 Neptune Core v0.19.1，改进并加固点对点网络。
summary.en: Released Neptune Core v0.19.1, which improves and hardens peer-to-peer networking.

summary.zh: 硬分叉 Delta 在 55,000 号区块生效：Triton VM 8 和交易串联上线。
summary.en: Hard Fork Delta activates at block 55,000: Triton VM 8 and transaction chaining go live.

no_probe_reason.en: No public block API found; explorer.neptune.cash returned HTTP 502 on 2026-11-27.
no_probe_reason.zh: 没有找到公开的出块接口；2026-11-27 访问 explorer.neptune.cash 返回 502 错误。

migration.en: Neptune spends are authorised by hash-preimage locks checked in STARK proofs, with no elliptic-curve signature, so there are no classical-key coins to move.
migration.zh: Neptune 的花费由 STARK 证明中校验的哈希原像锁授权，不用椭圆曲线签名，没有传统密钥下的币需要迁移。

audit.en: No published audit report was found. Spending uses hash locks checked in a STARK proof, not a signature.
audit.zh: 没有找到公开的审计报告。花费用 STARK 证明中校验的哈希锁，不用签名。

algo_note.en: Hash-preimage spending conditions and Triton STARK validity proofs. Programmable lock scripts.
algo_note.zh: 以哈希原像作为支出条件，并使用 Triton STARK 有效性证明。支持可编程锁定脚本。

stage_basis.en: Mainnet transfers have been signed with ML-DSA by default since launch on 9 September 2026.
stage_basis.zh: 主网自 2026-09-09 上线起，转账默认使用 ML-DSA 签名。

event.en: Block 1 of the mainnet; ML-DSA signatures were accepted from the start.
event.zh: 主网第 1 个区块；从一开始就接受 ML-DSA 签名。

algo.en: ML-DSA-87 (app default); ML-DSA-65 also accepted (command-line wallet default)
algo.zh: ML-DSA-87（App 默认）；也接受 ML-DSA-65（命令行钱包默认）

holder_can_use_today.en: Every transfer is signed with ML-DSA-87 or ML-DSA-65.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 每笔转账都用 ML-DSA-87 或 ML-DSA-65 签名。

note.en: Mainnet accepts both ML-DSA-87 and ML-DSA-65 signatures. The Quantus app SDK creates ML-DSA-87 accounts by default; the command-line wallet creates ML-DSA-65 accounts by default. Quantus and qtcchain both use QTC but are separate chains.
note.zh: 主网同时接受 ML-DSA-87 和 ML-DSA-65 签名。Quantus App 的 SDK 默认创建 ML-DSA-87 账户，命令行钱包默认创建 ML-DSA-65 账户。Quantus 和 qtcchain 都用 QTC 这个代号，但是两条不同的链。

latest_step.text: Node v1.0.5, a maintenance release. Mainnet launched 2026-09-09.
latest_step.zh: 节点 v1.0.5，维护版本。主网于 2026-09-09 上线。

milestones.name: Mainnet runtime accepts Dilithium87 and Dilithium65 (ML-DSA-87 and ML-DSA-65) signatures from the launch tag v1.0.0-gm onward.
milestones.zh: 主网运行时从上线版本 v1.0.0-gm 起就接受 Dilithium87 和 Dilithium65（即 ML-DSA-87 和 ML-DSA-65）签名。

summary.zh: Quantus 冷钱包上线：用一部闲置手机离线保管私钥，通过二维码传交易数据，签抗量子交易。
summary.en: Launched the Quantus Cold Wallet: a spare phone keeps keys offline and signs post-quantum transactions, with transaction data passed by QR code.

summary.zh: 主网上线一周回顾：从创世块起每笔交易都用抗量子签名，没有要迁移的旧 ECDSA 账户。
summary.en: Weekly recap after mainnet launch: every transaction has used post-quantum signatures since genesis, so there are no legacy ECDSA accounts to migrate.

summary.zh: 宣布 Quantus 主网上线，币只能靠挖矿获得。
summary.en: Announced that Quantus is live; coins can only be obtained by mining.

migration.en: Quantus mainnet has signed with ML-DSA by default since its 9 September 2026 launch, so there are no classical-key coins to move.
migration.zh: 自 2026 年 9 月 9 日主网上线起，Quantus 默认用 ML-DSA 签名，没有传统密钥下的币需要迁移。

audit.en: Neodyme audited the ML-DSA-87 library and HD wallet from November to December 2025; mainnet runs a later version, which also accepts ML-DSA-65.
audit.zh: Neodyme 在 2025 年 11 月至 12 月审计了 ML-DSA-87 库和分层钱包；主网运行的是之后的版本，还接受 ML-DSA-65。

algo_note.en: ML-DSA-87 and ML-DSA-65 transaction signing. Parameter-set selection within ML-DSA.
algo_note.zh: 交易使用 ML-DSA-87 和 ML-DSA-65 签名。可在 ML-DSA 的参数集之间选择。

stage_basis.en: Mainnet transfers are signed with ML-DSA-65 by default, with an SLH-DSA fallback leaf.
stage_basis.zh: 主网转账默认使用 ML-DSA-65 签名，另有 SLH-DSA 备用路径。

event.en: Genesis block of the mainnet, as shown by its block explorer.
event.zh: 主网的创世区块，见其区块浏览器。

holder_can_use_today.en: Every transfer is signed with ML-DSA-65, with an SLH-DSA fallback that has to be set up in advance.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 每笔转账都用 ML-DSA-65 签名，另有需要事先设定的 SLH-DSA 备用路径。

note.en: This is not a claim that every spend carries both signatures or that a new fallback can be added after a key is compromised.
note.zh: 并非每笔交易都带两种签名；密钥泄露后也无法再补加备用路径。

latest_step.text: Node v31.99.1, no consensus change. Mainnet launched 2026-09-26.

milestones.name: Mainnet genesis block, with ML-DSA-65 signing and SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s fallback leaves from the start.
milestones.zh: 主网创世区块，从一开始就用 ML-DSA-65 签名，另有 SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s 备用分支。

migration.en: xCoin spends use only ML-DSA-65 or SLH-DSA leaves with no ECDSA or Schnorr path, and mainnet began in September 2026, so there are no classical-key coins to move.
migration.zh: xCoin 的花费只走 ML-DSA-65 或 SLH-DSA 叶子，没有 ECDSA 或 Schnorr 路径，主网 2026 年 9 月才开始，没有传统密钥下的币需要迁移。

audit.en: No independent audit was found; the ML-DSA-65 code is a modified PQClean copy whose upstream version is not recorded.
audit.zh: 没有找到独立审计；ML-DSA-65 代码是改动过的 PQClean 副本，没有记录上游版本。

algo_note.en: ML-DSA-65 primary signing; SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s fallback leaves. Cross-family fallback requires committing to the alternative spending leaf in advance.
algo_note.zh: 主签名为 ML-DSA-65，备用分支为 SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s。跨签名族的备用路径需要事先承诺对应的支出分支。

stage_basis.en: Mainnet transfers are signed with ML-DSA-44 by default, with SLH-DSA as a fallback.
stage_basis.zh: 主网转账默认使用 ML-DSA-44 签名，SLH-DSA 作为备用。

event.en: Genesis block of the current mainnet (v2), which replaced the first mainnet launched on 30 September 2026.
event.zh: 现行主网（v2）的创世区块；它取代了 2026 年 9 月 30 日上线的第一版主网。

holder_can_use_today.en: Every transfer is signed with ML-DSA-44, with SLH-DSA as a fallback.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 每笔转账都用 ML-DSA-44 签名，SLH-DSA 作为备用。

note.en: Falcon is reserved in the reviewed specification. qtcchain is unrelated to Quantus despite the shared QTC ticker. The repository records a v2 treasury allocation; inclusion is not a fair-launch endorsement.
note.zh: Falcon 在规范中仅为预留。与 Quantus 无关。代码库记录了 v2 金库分配；收录不代表我们认为其发行公平。

latest_step.text: v0.2.5 (release notes dated 13 October; GitHub release published 20 October) disconnects peers older than protocol 800004 from mainnet height 4,000. Mainnet consensus unchanged.
latest_step.zh: v0.2.5（发布说明日期 10 月 13 日，GitHub 发布于 10 月 20 日）从主网第 4,000 号区块起断开协议版本低于 800004 的节点，主网共识不变。

milestones.name: Mainnet v1 starts (genesis block time 23:00 UTC), built from tag v0.1.0.
milestones.zh: 主网 v1 启动（创世区块时间 UTC 23:00），基于 v0.1.0 标签构建。

milestones.name: The project abandons mainnet v1 and restarts from a new genesis block (v0.2.0); block 1 must pay a 2,000,000 QTC treasury allocation.
milestones.zh: 项目放弃主网 v1，从新的创世区块重启（v0.2.0）；第 1 号区块必须支付 2,000,000 QTC 的金库分配。

milestones.name: Mainnet v2 block 1 mints 2,000,000 QTC to the project treasury address (project explorer).
milestones.zh: 主网 v2 第 1 号区块向项目金库地址铸出 2,000,000 QTC（项目自己的区块浏览器）。

migration.en: qtcchain v2 mainnet has signed with ML-DSA-44 by default since its October 2026 genesis, so there are no classical-key coins to move.
migration.zh: 自 2026 年 10 月创世起，qtcchain v2 主网默认用 ML-DSA-44 签名，没有传统密钥下的币需要迁移。

audit.en: No independent audit was found; the repository has the project's own review and an audit of inherited code outside the signature path.
audit.zh: 没有找到独立审计；仓库里只有项目自查，以及一份不涉及签名代码的继承代码审计。

supply.en: Block 1 of the current mainnet minted 2,000,000 QTC to the project treasury, about 8.7% of the 23,000,000 QTC total supply.
supply.zh: 现行主网第 1 号区块向项目金库铸出 2,000,000 QTC，约占总量 23,000,000 QTC 的 8.7%。

algo_note.en: ML-DSA-44 primary signing; SLH-DSA-SHAKE-128s fallback/multisig. Per-key scheme selection and multiple script leaves.
algo_note.zh: 主签名为 ML-DSA-44，SLH-DSA-SHAKE-128s 用于备用和多签。每把密钥可单独选择方案，并支持多个脚本分支。

stage_basis.en: Mainnet transfers are signed with ML-DSA-44 by default.
stage_basis.zh: 主网转账默认使用 ML-DSA-44 签名。

event.en: Block 1 of the mainnet, the first block its explorer shows, with post-quantum (PQ-WSH) outputs from the start.
event.zh: 主网第 1 个区块，也是区块浏览器能显示的第一个区块；从一开始就使用抗量子（PQ-WSH）输出。

holder_can_use_today.en: Every transfer is signed with ML-DSA-44.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 每笔转账都用 ML-DSA-44 签名。

note.en: XMSS experiments are not counted as a mainnet signing path. Public blocks do not establish user adoption or independent security certification.
note.zh: XMSS 试验不算主网上的签名方式。公开出块不代表有用户采用，也不代表通过独立安全认证。

latest_step.text: v2.6.1. A chain-ID rule scheduled in 2.6.0 applies from block 67,000.
latest_step.zh: v2.6.1。2.6.0 设定的链 ID 规则自第 67,000 号区块起生效。

milestones.name: Mainnet block 1, with post-quantum (PQ-WSH) outputs signed with ML-DSA-44 from the start.
milestones.zh: 主网第 1 个区块，从一开始就使用以 ML-DSA-44 签名的抗量子（PQ-WSH）输出。

summary.zh: 称 Halborn 审计了 1.6 万多行抗量子代码，范围包括链本身，30 个问题都在上线前修完；网络 10 月 13 日起运行。
summary.en: Says Halborn audited more than 16,000 lines of its post-quantum code, including the chain itself, and all 30 findings were fixed before launch; the network has run since Oct 13.

summary.zh: 主网上线一周：SoquShield 钱包已上架 iOS 和安卓。
summary.en: One week after mainnet launch, the SoquShield wallet is available on iOS and Android.

migration.en: Soqucoin has taken ECDSA out of transaction authorisation since block 0 and uses ML-DSA-44, so there are no classical-key coins to move.
migration.zh: Soqucoin 从第 0 个区块起就把 ECDSA 移出了交易授权，改用 ML-DSA-44，没有传统密钥下的币需要迁移。

audit.en: Halborn audited the ML-DSA-44 code, signature aggregation and wallet in Feb to Mar 2026 and marked every finding solved; the mainnet launched in October 2026, and later changes were not in scope.
audit.zh: Halborn 在 2026 年 2 月至 3 月审计了 ML-DSA-44 代码、签名聚合和钱包，所有发现都标为已修复；主网 2026 年 10 月才上线，之后的改动不在审计范围内。

algo_note.en: ML-DSA-44 transaction signing. One active transaction-signing scheme in the snapshot.
algo_note.zh: 交易使用 ML-DSA-44 签名。核查时只有这一种在用的交易签名方案。

stage_basis.en: Official documentation says XLINK pairs ML-DSA-65 with secp256k1 on the public testnet, but no primary source (code or a checked transaction) confirms it, so the stage is capped at 2 as a stated plan.
stage_basis.zh: 官方文档说测试网上 XLINK 把 ML-DSA-65 和 secp256k1 配对使用，但没有原始出处（代码或核对过的交易）能证实，所以按「官方说法」最高记 2 档。

holder_can_use_today.en: No post-quantum option on mainnet. The project documents ML-DSA-65 pairing (XLINK) on its testnet.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 主网没有抗量子选项。项目文档写了测试网上的 ML-DSA-65 配对（XLINK）。

note.en: The traded QANX token does not establish a live native post-quantum mainnet. The original 2024 announcement used the Dilithium name; do not backdate current parameters.
note.zh: QANX 代币在交易，不代表原生抗量子主网已上线。2024 年最初的公告用的是 Dilithium 这个名字，不要把现在的参数往前套。

latest_step.text: Testnet documentation adds the XLINK desktop app page (ML-DSA-65 with secp256k1). The network is still the QAN TestNet; mainnet has not launched.
latest_step.zh: 测试网文档新增 XLINK 桌面应用页面（ML-DSA-65 与 secp256k1）。网络仍是 QAN 测试网，主网尚未上线。

milestones.name: QAN testnet documentation adds the XLINK desktop app page: XLINK links a secp256k1 key with an ML-DSA-65 (FIPS 204) key on the QAN TestNet, a precursor to MainNet Beta.
milestones.zh: QAN 测试网文档新增 XLINK 桌面应用页面：XLINK 在 QAN 测试网上把 secp256k1 密钥和 ML-DSA-65（FIPS 204）密钥关联起来，测试网是 MainNet Beta 的前身。

milestones.name: QANscan, the TestNet explorer named in the QAN docs, shows the testnet producing blocks (block 4,148,845). No post-quantum signed transaction was checked.
milestones.zh: QAN 文档指定的测试网浏览器 QANscan 显示测试网在出块（第 4,148,845 号区块）。没有核对抗量子签名的交易。

summary.zh: 主网代码已写完；下周做内部复查和文档，11 月 30 日那一周把代码交给审计方。
summary.en: The mainnet codebase is complete; internal review and documentation come next week, with the code handed to the auditor in the week of Nov 30.

summary.zh: 10 月进展：执行层代码已交外部审计，并找到了不改动 Lighthouse 也能接入抗量子保护的办法。
summary.en: October update: the execution-layer code went to an external auditor, and the team found a way to add post-quantum protection without modifying Lighthouse.

summary.zh: 主网的共识层选定 Sigma Prime 开发的 Lighthouse。
summary.en: Chose Lighthouse by Sigma Prime as the consensus client for the mainnet stack.

note.en: No public node repository found
note.zh: 未找到公开的节点代码库

migration.en: QAN documents ML-DSA pairing with secp256k1 on its testnet only; no mainnet migration mechanism could be confirmed from primary sources.
migration.zh: QAN 只写了测试网上 ML-DSA 与 secp256k1 配对使用；从原始出处无法确认主网有迁移办法。

chains.name: Bitcoin Cash

stage_basis.en: CHIP-2026-06, a draft self-published by Bitcoin Cash developers, proposes SPHINCS+, Falcon and hybrid signatures. No node release includes it.
stage_basis.zh: Bitcoin Cash 开发者自行发布的草案 CHIP-2026-06 提议加入 SPHINCS+、Falcon 和混合签名，目前没有节点版本包含它。

algo.en: None at protocol level. Draft CHIP-2026-06 proposes SPHINCS+ and Falcon; third-party Quantumroot vaults use LM-OTS (RFC 8554).
algo.zh: 协议层暂无。CHIP-2026-06 草案提议 SPHINCS+ 和 Falcon；第三方 Quantumroot 金库合约用 LM-OTS（RFC 8554）。

holder_can_use_today.en: No protocol-level post-quantum signature. Holders can lock coins in third-party Quantumroot vault contracts, which add a hash-based LM-OTS spending path next to the normal Schnorr key.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 协议层没有抗量子签名。持币人可以把币放进第三方 Quantumroot 金库合约：在普通 Schnorr 密钥之外，多一条基于哈希的 LM-OTS 花费路径。

note.en: Quantumroot is unaudited third-party code. Its author advised in December 2025 against putting real funds in it before an audited wallet exists, and the Electron Cash plugin asks users to stick to small amounts.
note.zh: Quantumroot 是未经审计的第三方代码。作者 2025 年 12 月表示，在有经过审计的钱包之前不宜存入真实资金；Electron Cash 插件也提示只用小额。

today.en: No protocol-level post-quantum signature. Holders can lock coins in third-party Quantumroot vault contracts, which add a hash-based LM-OTS spending path next to the normal Schnorr key.
today.zh: 协议层没有抗量子签名。持币人可以把币放进第三方 Quantumroot 金库合约：在普通 Schnorr 密钥之外，多一条基于哈希的 LM-OTS 花费路径。

watch.en: Quantumroot is unaudited third-party code. Its author advised in December 2025 against putting real funds in it before an audited wallet exists, and the Electron Cash plugin asks users to stick to small amounts.
watch.zh: Quantumroot 是未经审计的第三方代码。作者 2025 年 12 月表示，在有经过审计的钱包之前不宜存入真实资金；Electron Cash 插件也提示只用小额。

can.en: Try a Quantumroot vault with small amounts (developer-preview contracts, prototype Electron Cash plugin), or keep standard addresses and follow CHIP-2026-06.
can.zh: 可以小额试用 Quantumroot 金库（开发者预览版合约、Electron Cash 原型插件），或者继续用普通地址，关注 CHIP-2026-06 的进展。

next.en: Whether node teams take CHIP-2026-06 into a network upgrade. Activation on chipnet, BCH's upgrade test network, would mean stage 3.
next.zh: 节点团队是否把 CHIP-2026-06 纳入网络升级。若在 BCH 的升级测试网 chipnet 上激活，即到 3 档。

latest_step.text: A prototype Electron Cash plugin for Quantumroot vaults was published; it is developer-tested only and unaudited.
latest_step.zh: Quantumroot 金库的 Electron Cash 原型插件发布，仅经开发者测试，未经审计。

milestones.name: May 2025 upgrade activates the VM Limits and BigInt CHIPs. VM Limits names post-quantum cryptography among the uses of larger stack items; no post-quantum signature is added.
milestones.zh: 2025 年 5 月升级激活 VM Limits 和 BigInt 两个 CHIP。VM Limits 把抗量子密码列为放宽栈元素上限的用途之一，但没有新增抗量子签名。

status.en: Activated on mainnet; general VM change
status.zh: 已在主网激活；通用虚拟机改动

milestones.name: Quantumroot published by bitjson: a vault contract in CashAssembly with a Schnorr path and an LM-OTS (RFC 8554) quantum path.
milestones.zh: bitjson 发布 Quantumroot：用 CashAssembly 写的金库合约，一条 Schnorr 路径，一条 LM-OTS（RFC 8554）抗量子路径。

status.en: Developer preview; third-party contract, not counted
status.zh: 开发者预览版；第三方合约，不计入档位

milestones.name: Quantumroot vaults run on chipnet, BCH's upgrade preview network, with contracts, tests and transaction-generation code.
milestones.zh: Quantumroot 金库在 BCH 升级预览网 chipnet 上运行，合约、测试和交易生成代码一并公开。

milestones.name: Forum proposal 'Quantum-Resistant Bitcoin Cash: A Challenge-Based Transition Protocol': commit now, reveal later, and move coins to a quantum-resistant address; needs a new consensus rule.
milestones.zh: 论坛提案「Quantum-Resistant Bitcoin Cash: A Challenge-Based Transition Protocol」：先承诺、后揭示，把币迁到抗量子地址；需要新增共识规则。

milestones.name: May 2026 upgrade activates the Loops, Functions, P2S and Bitwise CHIPs (BCHN v29.0.0), the building blocks Quantumroot needs. No post-quantum signature opcode is added.
milestones.zh: 2026 年 5 月升级激活 Loops、Functions、P2S、Bitwise 四个 CHIP（BCHN v29.0.0），即 Quantumroot 依赖的组件；没有新增抗量子签名操作码。

status.en: Activated on mainnet; general VM change
status.zh: 已在主网激活；通用虚拟机改动
