milestones.name: CHIP-2026-06 'Post-Quantum and Hybrid Signatures' (v0.1 draft): a public key's first byte selects the scheme, starting with SPHINCS+ and secp256k1 + post-quantum hybrids, spendable from ordinary P2PKH outputs; cites a Bitcoin Cash Node prototype.
milestones.zh: CHIP-2026-06「Post-Quantum and Hybrid Signatures」（v0.1 草案）：用公钥首字节选择签名方案，先上 SPHINCS+ 以及 secp256k1 加抗量子的混合签名，可从普通 P2PKH 输出花费；文中提到 Bitcoin Cash Node 原型。

status.en: Self-published draft under discussion; not in any BCHN release
status.zh: 作者自行发布的草案，讨论中；未进入任何 BCHN 版本

milestones.name: Prototype Electron Cash plugin for Quantumroot vaults; developer-tested only, unaudited, small amounts only.
milestones.zh: Quantumroot 金库的 Electron Cash 原型插件；仅经开发者测试，未经审计，只建议小额使用。

status.zh: 第三方钱包原型；不计入档位

claim.en: Press release (2026-05-26): OPTN and Paytaca wallets support Quantumroot vaults on mainnet, on Android and iOS.
claim.zh: 新闻稿（2026-05-26）称 OPTN 和 Paytaca 钱包已在主网支持 Quantumroot 金库，覆盖 Android 和 iOS。

reason.en: Community press release with no wallet versions and no audit; not checked against wallet release notes. Third-party wallets would not raise the stage anyway.
reason.zh: 社区新闻稿，没有给出钱包版本或审计信息，未与钱包发布说明核对；第三方钱包本来也不计入档位。

searched: upgradespecs.bitcoincashnode.org: 2025-05-15 and 2026-05-15 upgrade specs read; no post-quantum signature opcode; no 2027 upgrade listed

bitjson/bch-vm-limits, bch-bigint, bch-p2s, bch-loops, bch-functions, bch-bitwise READMEs grepped for quantum, Lamport, Winternitz, LM-OTS, SPHINCS: 'post-quantum' appears only as a motivation in VM Limits and Functions

gitlab.com/bitcoin-cash-node/bitcoin-cash-node (official; the GitHub repo is a mirror): merge requests and issues searched for 'quantum', 'post-quantum', 'sphincs', 'falcon' — none; release notes v28.0.1 to v29.2.0 (2026-10-01) checked
bitcoincashresearch.org search 'quantum' and 'CHIP-2026': CHIP-2026-06 (thread 1864, last post 2026-07-03), Quantumroot (1663), challenge-based transition (1804), plus general discussion threads
gitlab.com/mainnet-pat/chip-2026-06-generic-sigs README read (v0.1 draft, last repo activity 2026-08-09)
bitjson/quantumroot and fyookball/quantumroot-plugin READMEs read; GitHub issue/PR search 'quantumroot' in bitauth/libauth, paytaca/paytaca-app, Electron-Cash/Electron-Cash — none

chains.name: Litecoin

stage_basis.en: LIP-0003, the MWEB specification, mentions switching amount commitments to ElGamal later as a measure against quantum computers. That is a passing mention, not a quantum-related protocol change, and there is no post-quantum signature or migration proposal. A core maintainer said on 2026-09-09 that the team is looking into it.
stage_basis.zh: LIP-0003 是 MWEB 规范，其中提到以后把金额承诺换成 ElGamal，作为应对量子计算机的措施。这只是顺带一提，不是量子相关的协议改动；也没有抗量子签名或迁移提案。一位核心维护者 2026-09-09 表示团队正在研究。

holder_can_use_today.en: There is no post-quantum signature or migration proposal. MWEB, sometimes described as quantum resistant, still uses elliptic-curve keys and Schnorr signatures (LIP-0004).
holder_can_use_today.zh: 没有抗量子签名或迁移提案。MWEB 有时被说成抗量子，但它仍用椭圆曲线密钥和 Schnorr 签名（LIP-0004）。

note.en: An official Litecoin post in November 2025 called MWEB addresses quantum resistant, but an MWEB address is a pair of elliptic-curve public keys and MWEB inputs are signed with Schnorr.
note.zh: Litecoin 官方账号 2025 年 11 月称 MWEB 地址抗量子，但 MWEB 地址由两把椭圆曲线公钥组成，MWEB 输入用 Schnorr 签名。

today.en: There is no post-quantum signature or migration proposal. MWEB, sometimes described as quantum resistant, still uses elliptic-curve keys and Schnorr signatures (LIP-0004).
today.zh: 没有抗量子签名或迁移提案。MWEB 有时被说成抗量子，但它仍用椭圆曲线密钥和 Schnorr 签名（LIP-0004）。

watch.en: An official Litecoin post in November 2025 called MWEB addresses quantum resistant, but an MWEB address is a pair of elliptic-curve public keys and MWEB inputs are signed with Schnorr.
watch.zh: Litecoin 官方账号 2025 年 11 月称 MWEB 地址抗量子，但 MWEB 地址由两把椭圆曲线公钥组成，MWEB 输入用 Schnorr 签名。

can.en: No post-quantum option exists on Litecoin today.
can.zh: 目前 Litecoin 上没有抗量子选项。

next.en: A post-quantum LIP or code from the Litecoin core team (a maintainer said in September 2026 that they are looking into it).
next.zh: Litecoin 核心团队拿出抗量子 LIP 或代码（维护者 2026 年 9 月表示正在研究）。

latest_step.text: A Litecoin core maintainer replied on GitHub that the team is looking into it; no details or timeline.
latest_step.zh: Litecoin 核心维护者在 GitHub 上回复，团队正在研究这个问题；没有细节和时间表。

milestones.name: LIP-0003 (MWEB, Draft) says MimbleWimble will get an ElGamal switch commitment, to be activated by miner signaling if quantum computers become a threat, and that the implementation still needs discussion. It protects amount commitments, not holder keys.
milestones.zh: LIP-0003（MWEB，草案）提到 MimbleWimble 将带 ElGamal 切换承诺，量子计算机构成威胁时由矿工信号激活，并说明具体实现还要讨论。它保护的是金额承诺，不是持币人密钥。

milestones.name: Core maintainer on issue #1104 ('Quantum Security'): the team is looking into it.
milestones.zh: 核心维护者在议题 #1104（「Quantum Security」）下回复：团队正在研究。

status.en: Statement of intent; no public plan

milestones.name: litecoin-project/lips: no post-quantum LIP.
milestones.zh: litecoin-project/lips：没有抗量子 LIP。

claim.en: The official Litecoin account on X said MWEB addresses are quantum resistant (2025-11-23).
claim.zh: Litecoin 官方 X 账号称 MWEB 地址抗量子（2025-11-23）。

reason.en: Seen only through a news summary; the post gave no technical detail. Per LIP-0004, an MWEB address is a pair of elliptic-curve public keys and inputs are signed with Schnorr, so no post-quantum spend authorization is involved.
reason.zh: 只在新闻摘要中看到，原帖没有技术细节。按 LIP-0004，MWEB 地址是一对椭圆曲线公钥，输入用 Schnorr 签名，不涉及抗量子花费授权。

searched: litecoin-project/lips (cloned): grepped quantum, post-quantum, ML-DSA, Dilithium, Falcon, FN-DSA, SLH-DSA, SPHINCS, XMSS, Winternitz, lattice, Lamport — only LIP-0003's switch-commitment mention; open issue #18 (2022) is a user's wallet-encryption idea

chains.name: Kaspa

stage_basis.en: A Kaspa core developer (Ori Newman, author of KIP-17) opened KIP-22 'Pay-to-Public-Key-Hash via P2SH' as a Draft on 2026-10-19. It is an open pull request, not merged, and it hides keys only; it adds no post-quantum signature.
stage_basis.zh: Kaspa 核心开发者 Ori Newman（KIP-17 作者）于 2026-10-19 提交 KIP-22「Pay-to-Public-Key-Hash via P2SH」草案；该拉取请求尚未合并，只做公钥隐藏，不含抗量子签名。

holder_can_use_today.en: Nothing at the protocol level. A standard Kaspa address carries the 32-byte Schnorr public key itself, so the key is public wherever the address is. A wallet can already build P2SH addresses that hide the key until spending, but this is not a post-quantum signature.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 协议层没有。Kaspa 标准地址里直接就是 32 字节的 Schnorr 公钥，地址公开在哪里，公钥就公开在哪里。钱包现在就能用 P2SH 地址把公钥藏到花费时，但这不是抗量子签名。

note.en: Pay-to-public-key addresses expose keys from the start. KIP-22 (Draft, open PR #48) would standardise a hashed-key wallet convention with no consensus change; spends still reveal the key and remain breakable by a quantum computer. An older, different 'KIP22' P2MR pull request (#37, outside contributor) is also open.
note.zh: 直接付款给公钥的地址从一开始就暴露公钥。KIP-22（草案，PR #48）要把「哈希公钥」钱包做法标准化，不改共识；花费时仍会暴露公钥，量子计算机仍可破解。另有一个外部贡献者提交的、内容不同的旧「KIP22」P2MR 拉取请求（#37）也未合并。

can.zh: 没有抗量子选项。钱包可以用 P2SH 地址把公钥藏到花费时，也就是 KIP-22（#48）要标准化的做法；动币时公钥仍会暴露。

next.en: KIP-22 (#48) being merged (stage 2 at most, since it only hides keys), or a KIP that adds a post-quantum signature.
next.zh: KIP-22（#48）合并（它只隐藏公钥，最多 2 档），或出现加入抗量子签名的 KIP。

chains.name: NEAR Protocol

stage_basis.en: ML-DSA-65 keys have been live on mainnet since protocol version 85: any account can add one and sign transfers with it. Classical keys stay the default.
stage_basis.zh: ML-DSA-65 密钥自协议版本 85 起已在主网启用：任何账户都可以添加并用它签名转账，默认仍是传统密钥。

event.en: Mainnet upgraded from protocol version 84 to 86 at block 207,762,734, bringing in ML-DSA keys (stabilized in version 85).
event.zh: 主网在第 207,762,734 个区块从协议版本 84 直接升级到 86，带来 ML-DSA 密钥（在版本 85 中定稿）。

holder_can_use_today.en: A holder can add an ML-DSA-65 access key to an account and sign transactions with it; the official near-cli-rs can generate such keys.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 持币人可以给账户添加 ML-DSA-65 访问密钥，并用它签名交易；官方命令行工具 near-cli-rs 可以生成这类密钥。

note.en: Adding a post-quantum key does not remove the old ones: an Ed25519 or secp256k1 full-access key left on the account can still move the funds. Validator and block signatures are still Ed25519.
note.zh: 添加抗量子密钥不会删掉旧密钥：账户上只要还留着一把 Ed25519 或 secp256k1 完全访问密钥，就仍能用它转走资产。验证人和区块签名仍是 Ed25519。

today.en: A holder can add an ML-DSA-65 access key to an account and sign transactions with it; the official near-cli-rs can generate such keys.
today.zh: 持币人可以给账户添加 ML-DSA-65 访问密钥，并用它签名交易；官方命令行工具 near-cli-rs 可以生成这类密钥。

watch.en: Adding a post-quantum key does not remove the old ones: an Ed25519 or secp256k1 full-access key left on the account can still move the funds. Validator and block signatures are still Ed25519.
watch.zh: 添加抗量子密钥不会删掉旧密钥：账户上只要还留着一把 Ed25519 或 secp256k1 完全访问密钥，就仍能用它转走资产。验证人和区块签名仍是 Ed25519。

can.en: Add an ML-DSA-65 full-access key with near-cli-rs, then delete the classical keys. Since protocol version 88, new universal accounts (0u…) can be derived from post-quantum keys.
can.zh: 用 near-cli-rs 添加 ML-DSA-65 完全访问密钥，再删掉传统密钥。协议版本 88 起，新的通用账户（0u…）可以由抗量子密钥派生。

next.en: Stage 5 would need new accounts to use post-quantum keys by default. NEP-645 lists validator keys and on-chain verification host functions as follow-ups.
next.zh: 要到 5 档，需要新账户默认使用抗量子密钥。NEP-645 把验证人密钥和链上验证主机函数列为后续工作。

latest_step.text: NEP-655 Universal Accounts merged as Draft: post-quantum-capable implicit accounts, live since protocol version 88 (neard 2.14).
latest_step.zh: NEP-655 Universal Accounts 以草案状态合并：支持抗量子的隐式账户，协议版本 88（neard 2.14）起已上线。

milestones.name: nearcore PR #15731 merged: FIPS 204 ML-DSA-65 added as a third signature scheme; public keys are stored on-trie as a 32-byte SHA3-256 hash.
milestones.zh: nearcore PR #15731 合并：加入 FIPS 204 ML-DSA-65，作为第三种签名方案；公钥在状态树中以 32 字节 SHA3-256 哈希存储。

milestones.name: nearcore PR #15878 merged: ML-DSA-65 stabilized at protocol version 85.
milestones.zh: nearcore PR #15878 合并：ML-DSA-65 在协议版本 85 稳定启用。

milestones.name: neard 2.13.0 released with ML-DSA-65 stabilized; it upgrades the protocol from version 84 to 86.
milestones.zh: neard 2.13.0 发布，ML-DSA-65 稳定启用；协议版本从 84 升到 86。

milestones.name: near-cli-rs v0.28.0 adds ML-DSA-65 key generation (marked draft).
milestones.zh: near-cli-rs v0.28.0 加入 ML-DSA-65 密钥生成（标注为草案）。

status.zh: 已发布（官方命令行工具）

milestones.name: Mainnet voting for protocol version 86 begins (per the neard 2.13.0 release notes); ML-DSA-65 is active from version 85.
milestones.zh: 主网开始对协议版本 86 投票（据 neard 2.13.0 发布说明）；ML-DSA-65 自版本 85 起生效。

status.en: Live; mainnet RPC reported protocol version 88 on 2026-11-27
status.zh: 已上线；2026-11-27 主网 RPC 显示协议版本 88

milestones.name: NEP-645 'ML-DSA-65 Post-Quantum Transaction Signatures' merged (Draft): opt-in, per key; validator keys are out of scope.
milestones.zh: NEP-645「ML-DSA-65 Post-Quantum Transaction Signatures」合并（草案）：按密钥可选用；验证人密钥不在范围内。

milestones.name: neard 2.14.0 released; Universal Accounts, the first post-quantum-capable implicit accounts, are stabilized at protocol version 88.
milestones.zh: neard 2.14.0 发布；通用账户（首个支持抗量子的隐式账户方案）在协议版本 88 稳定启用。

milestones.name: NEP-655 'Universal Accounts' merged (Draft).
milestones.zh: NEP-655「Universal Accounts」合并（草案）。

summary.zh: 任何 NEAR 账户今天都能在主网上用一笔交易加一把 ML-DSA（FIPS 204）密钥，账户和资产不变；Meteor 等钱包已支持。
summary.en: Any NEAR account can add an ML-DSA (FIPS 204) key on mainnet in one transaction, keeping its account and assets; wallets such as Meteor support it.

summary.zh: 由 RFI 和 Safeheron 牵头的银行和监管机构联合体，在 NEAR 测试网上试点抗量子金融基础设施。
summary.en: A consortium of banks and regulators led by RFI and Safeheron is piloting post-quantum financial infrastructure on a NEAR testnet.

searched: near/NEPs (cloned): grepped quantum, ML-DSA, Dilithium, Falcon, FN-DSA, SLH-DSA, SPHINCS, XMSS, Winternitz, lattice, Lamport — NEP-645 (ML-DSA-65, Draft), NEP-646 (SHA-3 host functions, Draft), NEP-655 (Universal Accounts, Draft), NEP-641 (lists ML-DSA schemas as future work)

near/nearcore: PRs #15731 and #15878; releases 2.13.0 to 2.14.1; core/primitives-core/src/version.rs (MIN_SUPPORTED_PROTOCOL_VERSION = 85, UniversalAccounts => 88, FixMlDsaCostCharging still at nightly 157)
rpc.mainnet.near.org and rpc.testnet.near.org 'status': protocol_version 88, neard 2.14.1 (2026-11-27 14:07 UTC)
near/near-cli-rs, near/near-api-js, near/near-api-rs: ML-DSA support in releases and PRs (near-api-rs PR #155 still open)

migration.en: A NEAR holder can add an ML-DSA-65 access key to an existing account with near-cli-rs and then delete the classical keys.
migration.zh: NEAR 持币人可以用 near-cli-rs 给已有账户加一把 ML-DSA-65 访问密钥，再删掉传统密钥。

audit.en: No independent audit of the ML-DSA-65 integration was found.
audit.zh: 没有找到对 ML-DSA-65 集成的独立审计。

chains.name: Avalanche

stage_basis.en: No post-quantum research, roadmap or proposal from Ava Labs or the Avalanche Foundation. A community idea was closed without becoming an ACP.
stage_basis.zh: Ava Labs 和 Avalanche 基金会都没有抗量子研究、路线图或提案；一份社区设想被关闭，没有成为 ACP。

holder_can_use_today.en: Nothing at the protocol level.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 协议层没有。

note.en: Reports of internal Ava Labs work on hash-based signatures could not be checked against any Ava Labs or Avalanche Foundation source.
note.zh: 有报道称 Ava Labs 内部在研究基于哈希的签名，但找不到 Ava Labs 或 Avalanche 基金会的原始出处可以核对。

today.en: Nothing at the protocol level.
today.zh: 协议层没有。

watch.en: Reports of internal Ava Labs work on hash-based signatures could not be checked against any Ava Labs or Avalanche Foundation source.
watch.zh: 有报道称 Ava Labs 内部在研究基于哈希的签名，但找不到 Ava Labs 或 Avalanche 基金会的原始出处可以核对。

can.en: No post-quantum option exists on Avalanche today.
can.zh: 目前 Avalanche 上没有抗量子选项。

next.en: A post-quantum ACP in avalanche-foundation/ACPs; once merged as a proposal, that would mean stage 2.
next.zh: avalanche-foundation/ACPs 出现抗量子 ACP；作为提案合并即到 2 档。

latest_step.text: The community 'AIP-QR-001' post-quantum idea, filed as a README edit in the ACPs repo, was closed by the Foundation admin with a pointer to the ACP process.
latest_step.zh: 社区的「AIP-QR-001」抗量子设想以修改 README 的方式提交到 ACPs 库，被基金会管理员关闭，并提示按 ACP 流程提交。

milestones.name: Community idea 'AIP-QR-001' (Falcon and Dilithium precompiles, hybrid validator signatures, a migration path) submitted as a README edit in avalanche-foundation/ACPs (#278).
milestones.zh: 社区设想「AIP-QR-001」（Falcon 和 Dilithium 预编译、验证人混合签名、迁移路径）以修改 README 的方式提交到 avalanche-foundation/ACPs（#278）。

status.en: Closed 2026-02-24 by the Foundation admin; not an ACP
status.zh: 2026-02-24 被基金会管理员关闭；未成为 ACP

milestones.name: avalanche-foundation/ACPs: no quantum-related ACP.
milestones.zh: avalanche-foundation/ACPs：没有与量子相关的 ACP。

milestones.name: ava-labs/avalanchego issues and pull requests: nothing on post-quantum signatures.
milestones.zh: ava-labs/avalanchego 的议题和拉取请求：没有抗量子签名相关内容。

claim.en: Crypto Briefing (2026-10-09): an internal Ava Labs group is exploring hash-based approaches, and Ava Labs is weighing a 'cryptographic recovery mode' proposal.
claim.zh: Crypto Briefing（2026-10-09）称 Ava Labs 内部小组在研究基于哈希的方案，并在考虑一个「密码学恢复模式」提案。

reason.en: The article returned HTTP 403 and was seen only in a search summary; no Ava Labs or Avalanche Foundation source found.
reason.zh: 文章页面返回 403，只在搜索摘要中看到；没有找到 Ava Labs 或 Avalanche 基金会的原始出处。

searched: avalanche-foundation/ACPs (cloned): grepped quantum, ML-DSA, Dilithium, Falcon, FN-DSA, SLH-DSA, SPHINCS, XMSS, Winternitz, lattice, Lamport — no ACP; issues/PRs 'quantum': PR #278 (closed); Discussions 'quantum': #168 (P-Chain staking, unrelated)
ava-labs/avalanchego, ava-labs/subnet-evm, ava-labs/libevm issues/PRs 'quantum' — nothing post-quantum (ava-labs/coreth is archived)
GitHub Discussions org:ava-labs 'quantum' — none
forum.avax.network thread 7055 (the same AIP-QR-001 idea) could not be fetched (blocked); its text is in ACPs PR #278
Web search for an Ava Labs post-quantum roadmap — none found

network.block_interval_note: No fixed target since ACP-226 (dynamic minimum block delay, Activated). 0.8 s is the average of the last 100 C-Chain blocks, from timestampMilliseconds on the official RPC at 2026-11-27 14:19 UTC. The probe covers the C-Chain only.

chains.name: Polkadot

algo.en: None yet (research favours Falcon for accounts)
algo.zh: 暂无（研究方向倾向用 Falcon 保护账户）

holder_can_use_today.en: Nothing at the protocol level. DOT accounts sign with sr25519, ed25519 or ECDSA keys, and none of these is post-quantum.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 协议层面暂无。DOT 账户用 sr25519、ed25519 或 ECDSA 密钥签名，三者都不抗量子。

note.en: The only concrete account design, RFC #165, is an open draft, and its author writes that nothing can ship until NIST finalises FN-DSA (Falcon).
note.zh: 目前唯一具体的账户方案 RFC #165 还是未合并的草稿，作者本人写明在 NIST 定稿 FN-DSA（Falcon）之前无法上线。

today.en: Nothing at the protocol level. DOT accounts sign with sr25519, ed25519 or ECDSA keys, and none of these is post-quantum.
today.zh: 协议层面暂无。DOT 账户用 sr25519、ed25519 或 ECDSA 密钥签名，三者都不抗量子。

watch.en: The only concrete account design, RFC #165, is an open draft, and its author writes that nothing can ship until NIST finalises FN-DSA (Falcon).
watch.zh: 目前唯一具体的账户方案 RFC #165 还是未合并的草稿，作者本人写明在 NIST 定稿 FN-DSA（Falcon）之前无法上线。

can.en: Nothing protocol-level today. Follow RFC #165 for the proposed hybrid account design.
can.zh: 目前协议层面没有可用的办法。可以关注 RFC #165 里的混合账户方案。

next.en: RFC #165 being merged into polkadot-fellows/RFCs, and NIST's final FIPS 206 (FN-DSA), which the RFC waits for.
next.zh: RFC #165 合并进 polkadot-fellows/RFCs；以及该 RFC 所等待的 NIST FIPS 206（FN-DSA）正式定稿。

stage_basis.en: The Web3 Foundation has published a post-quantum roadmap, and RFC #165 (hybrid Falcon accounts) is an open pull request. Nothing is merged or in polkadot-sdk.
stage_basis.zh: Web3 基金会发布了抗量子路线图，RFC #165（Falcon 混合账户）仍是未合并的拉取请求；polkadot-sdk 中还没有相关代码。

latest_step.text: The author of RFC #165 added notes on threshold Falcon schemes and on ML-DSA versus FN-DSA benchmarks. The RFC is still an open draft.
latest_step.zh: RFC #165 作者补充了门限 Falcon 方案以及 ML-DSA 与 FN-DSA 性能对比的备注。该 RFC 仍是未合并的草稿。

milestones.name: Web3 Foundation research team publishes a post-quantum roadmap for Polkadot and JAM: Falcon for account signatures, ML-DSA elsewhere, and the current hash functions kept.
milestones.zh: Web3 基金会研究团队发布 Polkadot 与 JAM 的抗量子路线图：账户签名用 Falcon，其他环节用 ML-DSA，现有哈希函数继续沿用。

status.zh: 已发布路线图，未给日期

milestones.name: RFC #165 "Hybrid post-quantum accounts" opened by Web3 Foundation researcher Jeff Burdges: each account would pair a Falcon key with an ed25519 or sr25519 key.
milestones.zh: Web3 基金会研究员 Jeff Burdges 提交 RFC #165「混合抗量子账户」：每个账户在 ed25519 或 sr25519 密钥之外再配一把 Falcon 密钥。

milestones.name: Merged RFC texts in polkadot-fellows/RFCs and issues/PRs in paritytech/polkadot-sdk: no merged post-quantum change for accounts or consensus.
milestones.zh: polkadot-fellows/RFCs 已合并的 RFC 文本，以及 paritytech/polkadot-sdk 的 issue 和 PR：账户和共识都没有已合并的抗量子改动。

searched: polkadot-fellows/RFCs: all 54 merged text files grepped for quantum, post-quantum, PQ, ML-DSA, Dilithium, Falcon, FN-DSA, SLH-DSA, SPHINCS, XMSS, Winternitz, lattice, ML-KEM — none
polkadot-fellows/RFCs issues/PRs: 'quantum', 'post-quantum OR falcon OR lattice' — only open PR #165 (hybrid PQ accounts, draft); PR #144 (pre-ELVES) is not a PQ change

paritytech/polkadot-sdk issues/PRs: 'quantum', 'falcon', 'dilithium', 'ml-dsa', 'post-quantum' — only open issue #13010 (external contributor, PQ migration design for sc-mixnet transport, not accounts)
polkadot-fellows/runtimes issues/PRs: 'quantum' — none
forum.polkadot.network: W3F 'Post Quantum Cryptography Roadmap for Polkadot and JAM' thread (2025-06-05, 5 posts)
w3f/PPPs: archived since 2023; superseded by polkadot-fellows/RFCs

chains.name: Cosmos Hub

algo.en: ML-DSA-65 (FIPS 204) in the Cosmos SDK; not enabled on the Hub
algo.zh: Cosmos SDK 已支持 ML-DSA-65（FIPS 204）；Cosmos Hub 尚未启用

holder_can_use_today.en: Nothing on the Cosmos Hub. Accounts still sign with secp256k1; the ML-DSA-65 account keys in Cosmos SDK v0.55 reach ATOM holders only if the Hub upgrades to that SDK version.
holder_can_use_today.zh: Cosmos Hub 上暂无。账户仍用 secp256k1 签名；Cosmos SDK v0.55 里的 ML-DSA-65 账户密钥，要等 Hub 升级到这一版 SDK，ATOM 持币人才能用上。

note.en: Per the SDK docs there is no in-place migration for accounts: moving to ML-DSA means creating a new account and transferring funds. A rekeying PR (MsgChangePubKey) is still open.
note.zh: 按 SDK 文档，账户不能原地迁移：改用 ML-DSA 要新建账户再把资金转过去。允许账户换公钥的 PR（MsgChangePubKey）尚未合并。

today.en: Nothing on the Cosmos Hub. Accounts still sign with secp256k1; the ML-DSA-65 account keys in Cosmos SDK v0.55 reach ATOM holders only if the Hub upgrades to that SDK version.
today.zh: Cosmos Hub 上暂无。账户仍用 secp256k1 签名；Cosmos SDK v0.55 里的 ML-DSA-65 账户密钥，要等 Hub 升级到这一版 SDK，ATOM 持币人才能用上。

watch.en: Per the SDK docs there is no in-place migration for accounts: moving to ML-DSA means creating a new account and transferring funds. A rekeying PR (MsgChangePubKey) is still open.
watch.zh: 按 SDK 文档，账户不能原地迁移：改用 ML-DSA 要新建账户再把资金转过去。允许账户换公钥的 PR（MsgChangePubKey）尚未合并。

can.en: Nothing on the Hub yet. Developers can try ML-DSA-65 accounts on a local or test chain built with Cosmos SDK v0.55.
can.zh: Hub 上暂时没有办法。开发者可以在基于 Cosmos SDK v0.55 搭建的本地链或测试链上试用 ML-DSA-65 账户。

next.en: A Gaia release that moves the Hub to Cosmos SDK v0.55 or later, followed by the Hub's testnet and mainnet upgrade proposals.
next.zh: Gaia 发布基于 Cosmos SDK v0.55 及以上的版本，随后 Hub 在测试网和主网发起升级提案。

stage_basis.en: Cosmos SDK v0.55.0 ships ML-DSA-65 keys, but the Cosmos Hub still runs SDK v0.53.8 and accepts only ed25519 and secp256k1 signatures.
stage_basis.zh: Cosmos SDK v0.55.0 已支持 ML-DSA-65 密钥，但 Cosmos Hub 仍运行 SDK v0.53.8，只接受 ed25519 和 secp256k1 签名。

latest_step.text: gaia main bumped CometBFT to v0.38.26 so Hub light clients can verify counterparties with ML-DSA-65 validators; unreleased, and the Hub itself still accepts only ed25519 validator keys.
latest_step.zh: gaia 主干升级 CometBFT 至 v0.38.26，使 Hub 的轻客户端能验证使用 ML-DSA-65 验证者的对手链；尚未发布，Hub 自身仍只允许 ed25519 验证者密钥。

milestones.name: CometBFT PR #5875 merged: ML-DSA-65 key type for validators.
milestones.zh: CometBFT 合并 PR #5875：验证者可用 ML-DSA-65 密钥类型。

milestones.name: cosmos-sdk PR #26472 merged: ML-DSA-65 user account keys (keyring creation and recovery, transaction signing and verification, ante-handler gas cost); PR #26436 (validator keys) merged 2026-05-27.
milestones.zh: cosmos-sdk 合并 PR #26472：用户账户可用 ML-DSA-65 密钥（密钥库创建与恢复、交易签名与验证、ante 处理器 gas 成本）；验证者密钥 PR #26436 于 2026-05-27 合并。

milestones.name: Cosmos SDK v0.55.0 released with ML-DSA-65 account and validator keys; account keys need no chain-level permission once a chain runs v0.55.
milestones.zh: Cosmos SDK v0.55.0 发布，内含 ML-DSA-65 账户密钥和验证者密钥；链升级到 v0.55 后，账户密钥无需链上额外开启。

status.en: Released in the SDK; not adopted by the Cosmos Hub
status.zh: SDK 已发布；Cosmos Hub 未采用

milestones.name: Open cosmos-sdk PRs: #26865 (account rekeying via MsgChangePubKey, revised ADR-034) and #26872 (derive ML-DSA-65 keys in their own PQHD/BIP85 namespace).
milestones.zh: cosmos-sdk 未合并的 PR：#26865（通过 MsgChangePubKey 让账户换公钥，修订版 ADR-034）和 #26872（ML-DSA-65 密钥改用独立的 PQHD/BIP85 派生路径）。

milestones.name: gaia v29.1.0, the latest Cosmos Hub release, is built on Cosmos SDK v0.53.8, whose auth parameters price only ed25519 and secp256k1 signatures.
milestones.zh: Cosmos Hub 最新版本 gaia v29.1.0 基于 Cosmos SDK v0.53.8，其 auth 参数只给 ed25519 和 secp256k1 签名定价。

summary.zh: 抗量子共识密钥和零停机换钥已在 7 月 28 日随 Cosmos SDK v0.55.0、CometBFT v0.40 发布。
summary.en: Post-quantum consensus keys and zero-downtime key rotation shipped on July 28 in Cosmos SDK v0.55.0 and CometBFT v0.40.

chains.name: Internet Computer

consensus.zh: Internet Computer 共识（子网 BFT，由 NNS 治理）

holder_can_use_today.en: ICP accounts and neurons are controlled by elliptic-curve keys, and the network certifies its state with threshold BLS signatures; neither is post-quantum.
holder_can_use_today.zh: ICP 账户和神经元由椭圆曲线密钥控制，网络用门限 BLS 签名认证状态，两者都不抗量子。

note.en: The only formal step is a 2021 NNS motion that set a research goal; it carries no design, no dates and no code.
note.zh: 唯一的正式动作是 2021 年的一项 NNS 动议，只定了研究方向，没有方案、日期和代码。

today.en: ICP accounts and neurons are controlled by elliptic-curve keys, and the network certifies its state with threshold BLS signatures; neither is post-quantum.

can.en: Nothing protocol-level today.
can.zh: 目前协议层面没有可用的办法。

next.en: A DFINITY design or NNS proposal for post-quantum user signatures or a replacement for threshold BLS, or post-quantum signature code landing in dfinity/ic.
next.zh: DFINITY 发布抗量子用户签名或门限 BLS 替代方案的设计或 NNS 提案，或 dfinity/ic 合入抗量子签名代码。

stage_basis.en: NNS motion 35660 adopted post-quantum security as a long-term research goal in 2021. As of 2026-11-27, no post-quantum code or proposal found in dfinity/ic.
stage_basis.zh: NNS 第 35660 号动议在 2021 年把抗量子列为长期研究目标；截至 2026-11-27 未在 dfinity/ic 中找到抗量子代码或提案。

latest_step.text: A community member asked DFINITY on its forum for a post-quantum migration plan for threshold BLS; as of 2026-11-27 the thread has no reply from DFINITY.
latest_step.zh: 社区成员在 DFINITY 论坛询问门限 BLS 的抗量子迁移计划；截至 2026-11-27，帖子里没有 DFINITY 的回复。

milestones.name: NNS motion 35660 "Long Term R&D: PQ Security" adopted: objective "make the IC secure against quantum-capable attackers", led by Jens Groth and Andrea Cerulli.
milestones.zh: NNS 动议 35660「长期研发：抗量子安全」获通过：目标是让 IC 能抵御具备量子能力的攻击者，由 Jens Groth 和 Andrea Cerulli 牵头。

status.en: Adopted motion (research goal; no design or dates)
status.zh: 动议已通过（研究目标，无方案和日期）

milestones.name: dfinity/ic and dfinity/internet-identity issues and PRs: no post-quantum signature work.
milestones.zh: dfinity/ic 和 dfinity/internet-identity 的 issue 与 PR：没有抗量子签名相关工作。

claim.en: Forum users point to an X post by DFINITY founder Dominic Williams as DFINITY's "official answer" on quantum readiness, and read it as a stance against rushing it.
claim.zh: 论坛用户把 DFINITY 创始人 Dominic Williams 的一条 X 帖当作 DFINITY 对量子准备的「官方回答」，并解读为不主张仓促推进。

reason.en: Seen only through forum replies; the X post itself was not opened, and it is not a DFINITY publication.
reason.zh: 只在论坛回复里看到，没有打开那条 X 帖本身，它也不是 DFINITY 的正式发布。

summary.zh: 认为能破解密码的量子计算机 2030 年前不会出现；眼下更大的风险是 AI 可能攻破还不成熟的「抗量子」方案，比如 HAWK。
summary.en: Says cryptographically relevant quantum computers will not appear before 2030; the nearer risk is AI breaking immature "quantum-safe" schemes such as HAWK.

summary.zh: 认为加密行业更急需的是「抗 AI」的密码学，而不是「抗量子」的密码学。
summary.en: Argues crypto urgently needs "AI-safe" cryptography rather than "quantum-safe" cryptography.

chains.name: Stellar

consensus.zh: 恒星共识协议（SCP，联邦拜占庭协议）

holder_can_use_today.en: On mainnet, a Soroban contract account can now require an ML-DSA signature, since Protocol 30 added ML-DSA verification. Ordinary G… accounts and every transaction envelope still sign with Ed25519.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 主网上，Soroban 合约账户现在可以要求 ML-DSA 签名，因为 Protocol 30 加入了 ML-DSA 验证。普通 G… 账户和所有交易信封仍用 Ed25519 签名。

note.en: Protection exists only inside a custom contract account that someone has to write and deploy; no official ML-DSA account contract was found. A G… address is the Ed25519 public key itself, so classic accounts stay exposed until signer support arrives.
note.zh: 保护只存在于自定义合约账户里，合约得有人编写和部署，目前没找到官方的 ML-DSA 账户合约。G… 地址本身就是 Ed25519 公钥，在支持抗量子签名者之前，经典账户始终暴露在外。

today.en: On mainnet, a Soroban contract account can now require an ML-DSA signature, since Protocol 30 added ML-DSA verification. Ordinary G… accounts and every transaction envelope still sign with Ed25519.
today.zh: 主网上，Soroban 合约账户现在可以要求 ML-DSA 签名，因为 Protocol 30 加入了 ML-DSA 验证。普通 G… 账户和所有交易信封仍用 Ed25519 签名。

watch.en: Protection exists only inside a custom contract account that someone has to write and deploy; no official ML-DSA account contract was found. A G… address is the Ed25519 public key itself, so classic accounts stay exposed until signer support arrives.
watch.zh: 保护只存在于自定义合约账户里，合约得有人编写和部署，目前没找到官方的 ML-DSA 账户合约。G… 地址本身就是 Ed25519 公钥，在支持抗量子签名者之前，经典账户始终暴露在外。

can.en: Developers and wallets can build a Soroban custom account that checks ML-DSA signatures and hold XLM in it on mainnet. Ordinary users have no built-in option yet.
can.zh: 开发者和钱包可以编写校验 ML-DSA 签名的 Soroban 自定义账户，在主网上把 XLM 存进去。普通用户暂时没有内置选项。

next.en: The CAP that adds post-quantum signer types to classic G… accounts (stage 2 of SDF's Quantum Preparedness Plan, planned for 2027), and the signature-format discussion #2057 that prepares for it.
next.zh: 为经典 G… 账户加入抗量子签名者类型的 CAP（SDF 量子准备计划第二阶段，计划 2027 年），以及为此铺路的签名格式讨论 #2057。

stage_basis.en: CAP-0087 is implemented, and since Protocol 30 smart contracts on mainnet can verify ML-DSA signatures. Accounts still sign with Ed25519, and a contract account written by someone else does not count.
stage_basis.zh: CAP-0087 已实施，自协议版本 30 起主网合约可以验证 ML-DSA 签名；但账户仍使用 Ed25519 签名，他人编写的合约账户不计入档位。

latest_step.text: Protocol 30 activated on mainnet at ledger 65633432, putting CAP-0087's ML-DSA verification host functions live for Soroban contracts.
latest_step.zh: Protocol 30 在主网第 65633432 号账本激活，CAP-0087 的 ML-DSA 验证宿主函数对 Soroban 合约正式可用。

milestones.name: SDF publishes its Quantum Preparedness Plan: ML-DSA verification for Soroban contract accounts in 2026, a CAP adding post-quantum signers to classic G… accounts in 2027, and an Ed25519 cut-off whose timing depends on the threat. SCP validator signatures are to move in a separate upgrade. (Date from the page's metadata; the page shows none.)
milestones.zh: SDF 发布量子准备计划：2026 年为 Soroban 合约账户加入 ML-DSA 验证；2027 年用一项 CAP 让经典 G… 账户可添加抗量子签名者；停用 Ed25519 的时间视威胁而定。SCP 验证者签名另行升级。（日期取自页面元数据，页面上没有显示。）

milestones.name: CAP-0087 "Host functions for ML-DSA signature verification" merged as a draft; moved to Accepted on 2026-10-07 and Implemented for Protocol 30.
milestones.zh: CAP-0087「ML-DSA 签名验证宿主函数」以草稿合并；2026-10-07 转为 Accepted，随后在 Protocol 30 中标为 Implemented。

milestones.name: stellar-core v30.0.0 and rs-soroban-env v30.0.0 released with Protocol 30 support, including the ML-DSA host functions.
milestones.zh: stellar-core v30.0.0 与 rs-soroban-env v30.0.0 发布，支持 Protocol 30，含 ML-DSA 宿主函数。

milestones.name: SDF's Nicolas Barry opens discussion #2057 on a new signature format "as we add post-quantum keys as account signers" (key identifiers, scoped signatures).
milestones.zh: SDF 的 Nicolas Barry 发起讨论 #2057，提出在「为账户加入抗量子签名者」的同时改造签名格式（密钥标识、限定范围的签名）。

milestones.name: Protocol 30 live on mainnet from ledger 65633432 (StellarExpert shows protocol 30 from this ledger; the ledger before it is protocol 29): Soroban contracts can verify ML-DSA-44/65/87 signatures. Classic accounts and transaction signatures are unchanged.
milestones.zh: Protocol 30 自第 65633432 号账本起在主网生效（StellarExpert 显示从这个账本起为协议版本 30，前一个账本为 29）：Soroban 合约可以验证 ML-DSA-44/65/87 签名。经典账户和交易签名不变。

status.en: Live on mainnet, contract level only (does not raise the stage)
status.zh: 主网已上线，仅限合约层（不提升档位）

summary.zh: Protocol 30（Bell）已在主网上线；这次升级「开始做抗量子签名」。
summary.en: Protocol 30 (Bell) is live on mainnet; the upgrade begins work on post-quantum signatures.

summary.zh: 发布 Protocol 30（Bell）：目标之一是开始做抗量子签名；测试网 11 月 3 日、主网 11 月 23 日升级。
summary.en: Introduced Protocol 30 (Bell), which begins work on post-quantum signatures; testnet Nov 3, mainnet Nov 23.

migration.en: Stellar's Quantum Preparedness Plan would let classic accounts add a post-quantum signer through set_options in 2027, after which the old signer can be removed.
migration.zh: Stellar 的量子准备计划提出，2027 年让经典账户通过 set_options 添加抗量子签名者，之后可以移除旧签名者。

chains.name: TON

holder_can_use_today.en: TON wallets are smart contracts that check Ed25519 signatures, and the TVM has no post-quantum signature instruction a wallet could use instead.
holder_can_use_today.zh: TON 钱包是校验 Ed25519 签名的智能合约，TVM 也没有可供钱包改用的抗量子签名指令。

note.en: Even a custom wallet contract cannot switch to ML-DSA or Falcon until the TVM gains an instruction to verify such signatures.
note.zh: 在 TVM 加入相应的验签指令之前，即使自己写钱包合约，也无法改用 ML-DSA 或 Falcon。

today.en: TON wallets are smart contracts that check Ed25519 signatures, and the TVM has no post-quantum signature instruction a wallet could use instead.
today.zh: TON 钱包是校验 Ed25519 签名的智能合约，TVM 也没有可供钱包改用的抗量子签名指令。

watch.zh: 在 TVM 加入相应的验签指令之前，即使自己写钱包合约，也无法改用 ML-DSA 或 Falcon。

can.zh: 目前协议层面没有可用的办法。

next.zh: 出现抗量子验签相关的 TEP 或 TVM 指令提案，或 TON Core 就量子迁移表态。

stage_basis.en: No post-quantum research, roadmap or proposal from TON Core or the TON Foundation.
stage_basis.zh: TON Core 和 TON 基金会都没有抗量子研究、路线图或提案。

latest_step.text: Node release v2026.11; its changelog has no post-quantum changes.
latest_step.zh: 节点发布 v2026.11，更新日志中没有抗量子相关改动。

chains.name: Sui

holder_can_use_today.en: On Sui testnet, accounts can sign transactions with ML-DSA-65, on their own or as a multisig member alongside an Ed25519 key.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 在 Sui 测试网上，账户可以用 ML-DSA-65 签名交易，可以单独使用，也可以和 Ed25519 密钥一起组成多签。

note.en: Testnet only: mainnet still has mldsa65_auth switched off, and the Sui Foundation calls its Q1 2027 mainnet date a target, not a commitment.
note.zh: 仅限测试网：主网的 mldsa65_auth 仍是关闭状态，Sui 基金会给出的 2027 年第一季度主网时间只是目标，不是承诺。

today.en: On Sui testnet, accounts can sign transactions with ML-DSA-65, on their own or as a multisig member alongside an Ed25519 key.
today.zh: 在 Sui 测试网上，账户可以用 ML-DSA-65 签名交易，可以单独使用，也可以和 Ed25519 密钥一起组成多签。

watch.en: Testnet only: mainnet still has mldsa65_auth switched off, and the Sui Foundation calls its Q1 2027 mainnet date a target, not a commitment.
watch.zh: 仅限测试网：主网的 mldsa65_auth 仍是关闭状态，Sui 基金会给出的 2027 年第一季度主网时间只是目标，不是承诺。

can.en: Developers can create ML-DSA-65 addresses and send test transactions on Sui testnet. Mainnet SUI stays on classical keys for now.
can.zh: 开发者可以在 Sui 测试网创建 ML-DSA-65 地址并发送测试交易。主网 SUI 目前仍用传统密钥。

next.en: mldsa65_auth switched on in a mainnet protocol version (Sui Foundation target: Q1 2027).
next.zh: 主网协议版本打开 mldsa65_auth（Sui 基金会目标：2027 年第一季度）。

stage_basis.en: ML-DSA-65 account signatures are switched on in Sui's public testnet: the protocol config enables them on every network except mainnet from protocol 143, and testnet runs protocol 144. The latest mainnet release, at protocol 142, still has them off.
stage_basis.zh: Sui 公开测试网已启用 ML-DSA-65 账户签名：协议配置从协议版本 143 起在主网以外的所有网络打开它，测试网现运行协议版本 144。最新主网版本处于协议版本 142，尚未启用。

latest_step.text: Sui testnet release testnet-v1.85.1 (protocol version 144) carries ML-DSA-65 account signatures, which the protocol config switches on for testnet from protocol 143.
latest_step.zh: Sui 测试网版本 testnet-v1.85.1（协议版本 144）带有 ML-DSA-65 账户签名；协议配置从协议版本 143 起在测试网打开它。

milestones.name: Mysten Labs researchers (Baldimtsi, Chalkias, Roy, Sedaghat) publish "Post-Quantum Readiness in EdDSA Chains": an EdDSA seed can serve as the witness in a zero-knowledge proof that authorises a new post-quantum key, without changing the address.
milestones.zh: Mysten Labs 研究人员（Baldimtsi、Chalkias、Roy、Sedaghat）发表《EdDSA 链的抗量子准备》：用 EdDSA 种子作为零知识证明的见证，授权新的抗量子密钥，无需更换地址。

milestones.name: Sui Foundation's "Making Sui Quantum Ready": native ML-DSA-65 accounts (testnet by end of 2026, mainnet Q1 2027 target), SLH-DSA vaults in Move, and address aliases so existing accounts can switch to a post-quantum key.
milestones.zh: Sui 基金会发布《让 Sui 做好量子准备》：原生 ML-DSA-65 账户（2026 年底前上测试网，主网目标 2027 年第一季度）、在 Move 中实现的 SLH-DSA 金库，以及让现有账户改用抗量子密钥的地址别名。

milestones.name: MystenLabs/fastcrypto PR #1001 merged: fastcrypto-pq, an ML-DSA-65 layer over mysten-mldsa-native-rs.
milestones.zh: MystenLabs/fastcrypto 合并 PR #1001：fastcrypto-pq，基于 mysten-mldsa-native-rs 的 ML-DSA-65 封装层。

milestones.name: MystenLabs/sui PR #27810 merged: ML-DSA-65 account signature scheme (flag 0x07), devnet only from protocol 139, gated by mldsa65_auth.
milestones.zh: MystenLabs/sui 合并 PR #27810：ML-DSA-65 账户签名方案（标志位 0x07），自协议版本 139 起仅在开发网启用，由 mldsa65_auth 控制。

milestones.name: MystenLabs/sui PR #28530 merged: mldsa65_auth set for testnet in protocol 143; mainnet stays off.
milestones.zh: MystenLabs/sui 合并 PR #28530：协议版本 143 在测试网打开 mldsa65_auth；主网保持关闭。

milestones.name: Testnet release testnet-v1.85.1 (Sui protocol version 144). From protocol 143 the protocol config switches on mldsa65_auth (ML-DSA-65 account signatures) on every network except mainnet, so ML-DSA-65 signatures can authorise testnet transfers.
milestones.zh: 测试网版本 testnet-v1.85.1（Sui 协议版本 144）。从协议版本 143 起，协议配置在主网以外的所有网络打开 mldsa65_auth（ML-DSA-65 账户签名），ML-DSA-65 签名可以授权测试网转账。

milestones.name: The latest mainnet release, mainnet-v1.84.2, is at protocol 142; the protocol config leaves mldsa65_auth off on mainnet.
milestones.zh: 最新主网版本 mainnet-v1.84.2 处于协议版本 142；协议配置让主网的 mldsa65_auth 保持关闭。

migration.en: On Sui testnet an account can sign with ML-DSA-65, so test coins can be sent to a post-quantum address; mainnet still has it off, and in-place address aliases are a Q1 2027 target.
migration.zh: 在 Sui 测试网上，账户可以用 ML-DSA-65 签名，测试币可以转到抗量子地址；主网仍未开启，原地启用地址别名的目标是 2027 年第一季度。

audit.en: No independent audit of the Sui integration was found. The underlying mldsa-native library has formal proofs, which Mysten Labs re-ran.
audit.zh: 没有找到对 Sui 集成代码的独立审计。底层 mldsa-native 库有形式化证明，Mysten Labs 重新跑过。

chains.name: Hedera

algo.en: None yet (roadmap: FN-DSA, with ML-DSA as fallback)

consensus.zh: 哈希图（Hashgraph，异步拜占庭容错，按质押加权）

holder_can_use_today.en: Hedera accounts use Ed25519 or ECDSA secp256k1 keys, and Hedera itself says neither is quantum-resistant.
holder_can_use_today.zh: Hedera 账户用 Ed25519 或 ECDSA secp256k1 密钥，Hedera 官方也说两者都不抗量子。

note.en: Claims that Hedera is "quantum-resistant" refer to its SHA-384 hashing; account keys and transaction signatures are not post-quantum.
note.zh: 「Hedera 抗量子」的说法指的是它用 SHA-384 做哈希；账户密钥和交易签名并不抗量子。

today.en: Hedera accounts use Ed25519 or ECDSA secp256k1 keys, and Hedera itself says neither is quantum-resistant.
today.zh: Hedera 账户用 Ed25519 或 ECDSA secp256k1 密钥，Hedera 官方也说两者都不抗量子。

watch.en: Claims that Hedera is "quantum-resistant" refer to its SHA-384 hashing; account keys and transaction signatures are not post-quantum.
watch.zh: 「Hedera 抗量子」的说法指的是它用 SHA-384 做哈希；账户密钥和交易签名并不抗量子。

can.en: Nothing protocol-level today.
can.zh: 目前协议层面没有可用的办法。

next.en: A HIP that adds a post-quantum key type to the Hedera API (Hedera targets 2027, after NIST finalises FIPS 206).
next.zh: 为 Hedera API 加入抗量子密钥类型的 HIP（Hedera 目标 2027 年，待 NIST 定稿 FIPS 206 之后）。

stage_basis.en: Hedera's official roadmap plans a post-quantum user key type for 2027. No signature HIP is merged.
stage_basis.zh: Hedera 官方路线图计划在 2027 年推出抗量子用户密钥类型，目前没有签名相关的 HIP 合并。

latest_step.text: Hedera's blog set out its plan: hybrid Ed25519 and FN-DSA event signing, then a post-quantum user key type targeted for 2027.
latest_step.zh: Hedera 官方博客公布计划：先用 Ed25519 加 FN-DSA 的混合事件签名，再推出抗量子用户密钥类型，目标 2027 年。

milestones.name: Community HIP PR #1103 "Support for Post-Quantum Cryptographic Algorithm" opened; closed as stagnant on 2025-12-06.
milestones.zh: 社区提交 HIP PR #1103「支持抗量子密码算法」；2025-12-06 因长期无进展被关闭。

milestones.name: Community HIP PR #1437 "HIP-1399: Post-Quantum Cryptography Readiness Assessment" opened; closed as stagnant on 2026-06-09.
milestones.zh: 社区提交 HIP PR #1437「HIP-1399：抗量子密码准备度评估」；2026-06-09 因长期无进展被关闭。

milestones.name: Hedera blog (Ed Marquez, Leemon Baird, Rohit Sinha): SHA-384 and AES-256 are already post-quantum, signatures are not; plan is PQ TLS for nodes and clients, hybrid Ed25519 + FN-DSA event signing, then a post-quantum user key type targeted for 2027 (ML-DSA if FIPS 206 slips).
milestones.zh: Hedera 博客（Ed Marquez、Leemon Baird、Rohit Sinha）：SHA-384 和 AES-256 已经抗量子，签名还不是；计划先给节点和客户端上抗量子 TLS，再把事件签名改成 Ed25519 + FN-DSA 混合，最后加入抗量子用户密钥类型，目标 2027 年（FIPS 206 推迟则改用 ML-DSA）。

status.zh: 计划（用户密钥目标 2027 年）

summary.zh: Hedera 联合创始人 Leemon Baird 谈 DeRec 标准：不用托付他人也能保护密钥等秘密；DeRec 联盟把它作为抗量子的开放标准推进。
summary.en: Co-founder Leemon Baird on the DeRec standard, which protects secrets such as keys without trusting others to hold them; the DeRec Alliance advances it as an open, quantum-resistant standard.

searched: hiero-ledger/hiero-improvement-proposals (formerly hashgraph/hedera-improvement-proposal, 190 text files) grepped for quantum, post-quantum, PQ, ML-DSA, Dilithium, Falcon, FN-DSA, SLH-DSA, SPHINCS, XMSS, Winternitz, lattice, ML-KEM — HIP-1424 (hash choice), HIP-1334 and HIP-1535 (passing mentions); no signature HIP
hiero-improvement-proposals issues/PRs: 'quantum' — PRs #1103 and #1437 (community, closed as stagnant)
hiero-ledger/hiero-consensus-node (formerly hashgraph/hedera-services) issues/PRs: 'quantum' — issue #24840 and PR #25325 (PQ TLS, open); no PQ signature work
hedera.com blog: 'Post-Quantum Cryptography and Blockchain' (2026-04-10, modified 2026-04-30)

chains.name: XDC Network

algo.en: None for holders (Falcon prototype for validator signatures)
algo.zh: 持币人暂无（验证者签名有 Falcon 原型）

holder_can_use_today.en: XDC accounts are Ethereum-style secp256k1 accounts, and no post-quantum signing has been merged into the node software.
holder_can_use_today.zh: XDC 账户是以太坊式的 secp256k1 账户，节点软件也没有合入任何抗量子签名。

note.en: Pages on xdc.network tick off post-quantum precompiles and account abstraction as done, yet label those same phases "Upcoming"; we found no matching XIP or merged code.
note.zh: xdc.network 上的页面把抗量子预编译和账户抽象打了勾，同一页面却把这些阶段标为「即将开始」；我们没有找到对应的 XIP 或已合并的代码。

today.en: XDC accounts are Ethereum-style secp256k1 accounts, and no post-quantum signing has been merged into the node software.
today.zh: XDC 账户是以太坊式的 secp256k1 账户，节点软件也没有合入任何抗量子签名。

watch.en: Pages on xdc.network tick off post-quantum precompiles and account abstraction as done, yet label those same phases "Upcoming"; we found no matching XIP or merged code.
watch.zh: xdc.network 上的页面把抗量子预编译和账户抽象打了勾，同一页面却把这些阶段标为「即将开始」；我们没有找到对应的 XIP 或已合并的代码。

can.en: Nothing protocol-level today.
can.zh: 目前协议层面没有可用的办法。

next.en: An XIP for post-quantum signatures, or the Falcon prototype being merged into XDPoSChain's main branch.
next.zh: 出现抗量子签名的 XIP，或 Falcon 原型合并进 XDPoSChain 主分支。

stage_basis.en: A Falcon prototype for validator signatures sits on an unmerged branch of XDPoSChain. Nothing covers holder accounts.
stage_basis.zh: XDPoSChain 的一个未合并分支中有用于验证者签名的 Falcon 原型，还没有涉及持币人账户的内容。

latest_step.text: Last commit on the Falcon prototype branch: benchmarks for verifying XDC block headers with Falcon.
latest_step.zh: Falcon 原型分支的最后一次提交：用 Falcon 验证 XDC 区块头的性能测试。

milestones.name: Falcon prototype branch poc_falcon in XinFinOrg/XDPoSChain: adds a Falcon dependency, signs and verifies blocks, votes, quorum certificates and timeouts with Falcon, with benchmarks (commits from 2025-06-28).
milestones.zh: XinFinOrg/XDPoSChain 的 Falcon 原型分支 poc_falcon：引入 Falcon 依赖，用 Falcon 签名和验证区块、投票、法定人数证书和超时消息，并附性能测试（首次提交于 2025-06-28）。

status.zh: 未合并的原型（仅验证者签名）

milestones.name: XIP repositories: XDC-Community/XIPs.github.io (3 XIPs, last updated 2023) and XinFinOrg/XIP (empty) contain no post-quantum proposal.
milestones.zh: XIP 仓库：XDC-Community/XIPs.github.io（3 个 XIP，2023 年后未更新）和 XinFinOrg/XIP（空仓库）都没有抗量子提案。

claim.en: xdc.network says an "XDC PQ Initiative" launched in March 2026 with a four-phase plan to 2030, a PQ Security Council, an "XIP-PQ-001" community vote, and items such as ML-DSA/Falcon EVM precompiles marked as done.
claim.zh: xdc.network 称「XDC PQ 计划」于 2026 年 3 月启动，分四个阶段推进到 2030 年，设有「量子安全委员会」，有「XIP-PQ-001」社区投票，并把 ML-DSA/Falcon EVM 预编译等事项标为已完成。

reason.en: The site's source sits in the XDCIndia GitHub organisation (XDC Innovation Labs) and its footer says "Redesign preview"; its checkmarks contradict its own "Upcoming" labels, and XIP-PQ-001 is not in either XIP repository.
reason.zh: 该网站源码在 GitHub 的 XDCIndia 组织（XDC Innovation Labs）名下，页脚写着「Redesign preview」；页面上的勾选与它自己标注的「即将开始」相矛盾，两个 XIP 仓库里也都没有 XIP-PQ-001。

searched: XDC-Community/XIPs.github.io (XDC Network Improvement Proposal repo, 10 text files) grepped for quantum, post-quantum, PQ, ML-DSA, Dilithium, Falcon, FN-DSA, SLH-DSA, SPHINCS, XMSS, Winternitz, lattice, ML-KEM — none
XinFinOrg/XIP: repository is empty
XinFinOrg/XDPoSChain issues/PRs: 'quantum', 'falcon OR ML-DSA OR dilithium OR post-quantum' — none; branch list — poc_falcon (unmerged, 5 commits ahead, 1577 behind dev-upgrade)
XinFinOrg/Docs issues/PRs: 'quantum' — none
xdc.network quantum pages (roadmap); operator checked via the XDCIndia GitHub org

chains.name: Canton Network

consensus.en: BFT sequencing by Super Validators (Global Synchronizer)
consensus.zh: 由超级验证者进行 BFT 排序（Global Synchronizer）

holder_can_use_today.en: Nothing on the public network. Parties holding CC sign with elliptic-curve keys (Ed25519 by default); ML-DSA-65 exists in Canton only behind an experimental switch.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 公共网络上暂无。持有 CC 的参与方用椭圆曲线密钥签名（默认 Ed25519）；ML-DSA-65 在 Canton 里只能通过实验开关启用。

note.en: Experimental features are not meant for production, and Digital Asset says the wider migration (other schemes, encryption, wallets, MPC, exchanges) is still being mapped out.
note.zh: 实验功能不适合生产环境；Digital Asset 也表示，更大范围的迁移（其他签名方案、加密、钱包、MPC、交易所）仍在规划中。

today.en: Nothing on the public network. Parties holding CC sign with elliptic-curve keys (Ed25519 by default); ML-DSA-65 exists in Canton only behind an experimental switch.
today.zh: 公共网络上暂无。持有 CC 的参与方用椭圆曲线密钥签名（默认 Ed25519）；ML-DSA-65 在 Canton 里只能通过实验开关启用。

watch.en: Experimental features are not meant for production, and Digital Asset says the wider migration (other schemes, encryption, wallets, MPC, exchanges) is still being mapped out.
watch.zh: 实验功能不适合生产环境；Digital Asset 也表示，更大范围的迁移（其他签名方案、加密、钱包、MPC、交易所）仍在规划中。

can.en: Nothing for CC holders yet. Node operators can test ML-DSA-65 in their own Canton deployments by enabling the experimental flag.
can.zh: CC 持币人暂时没有办法。节点运营方可以在自己的 Canton 部署里打开实验开关，测试 ML-DSA-65。

next.en: ML-DSA-65 leaving experimental status in a Canton release, and a CIP or synchronizer change that lets parties on the Global Synchronizer use ML-DSA keys.
next.zh: Canton 正式版取消 ML-DSA-65 的实验标记，以及出现允许全局同步器上的参与方使用 ML-DSA 密钥的 CIP 或同步器改动。

stage_basis.en: Canton's crypto provider includes ML-DSA-65 only behind an experimental flag, and no CIP covers post-quantum signatures.
stage_basis.zh: Canton 的密码模块只在实验开关后提供 ML-DSA-65，也没有关于抗量子签名的 CIP。

latest_step.text: Digital Asset's mid-2026 update: Canton plans to implement post-quantum algorithms over the next 6–12 months; ML-DSA signing is available behind an experimental flag.
latest_step.zh: Digital Asset 2026 年年中更新：Canton 计划在未来 6 到 12 个月内实现抗量子算法；ML-DSA 签名已可通过实验开关使用。

milestones.name: Digital Asset's position on post-quantum cryptography: Canton's cryptography is pluggable so new signature and encryption schemes can be added; the main near-term risk named is store-now-decrypt-later.
milestones.zh: Digital Asset 发布抗量子密码立场：Canton 的密码模块可插拔，能加入新的签名和加密方案；文中点名的近期主要风险是「先存后解」。

milestones.name: PostQuantumCryptoIntegrationTest appears in digital-asset/canton: participants and synchronizers with ML-DSA-65 enabled through enableExperimental.
milestones.zh: digital-asset/canton 出现 PostQuantumCryptoIntegrationTest：参与节点和同步器通过 enableExperimental 启用 ML-DSA-65。

milestones.name: Digital Asset's mid-2026 update: implement PQC over the next 6–12 months; ML-DSA signing behind an experimental flag; migration in three steps (implement schemes, ecosystem support, move parties to PQC keys).
milestones.zh: Digital Asset 2026 年年中更新：未来 6 到 12 个月实现抗量子密码；ML-DSA 签名已可通过实验开关使用；迁移分三步（实现算法、生态支持、参与方改用抗量子密钥）。

milestones.name: Canton release v3.7.5: the JCE crypto provider still lists ML-DSA-65 among supported signing keys and algorithms; the default remains Ed25519.
milestones.zh: Canton 发布 v3.7.5：JCE 密码提供方仍把 ML-DSA-65 列为支持的签名密钥和算法；默认仍是 Ed25519。

milestones.name: canton-foundation/cips: no post-quantum CIP ("CC Quantum" in CIP-0114 is an unrelated holdings unit).
milestones.zh: canton-foundation/cips：没有抗量子相关的 CIP（CIP-0114 中的「CC Quantum」是与此无关的持仓单位）。

searched: canton-foundation/cips (formerly global-synchronizer-foundation/cips, 124 text files) grepped for quantum, post-quantum, PQ, ML-DSA, Dilithium, Falcon, FN-DSA, SLH-DSA, SPHINCS, XMSS, Winternitz, lattice, ML-KEM — only 'CC Quantum' in CIP-0114 (unrelated); issues/PRs 'quantum' — none
digital-asset/canton, canton-network/splice, digital-asset/daml issues/PRs: 'quantum' and 'ML-DSA OR falcon OR dilithium OR post-quantum OR SLH-DSA' — none
digital-asset/canton code search 'MlDsa' / 'SigningKeySpec.MlDsa65': CryptoProvider.scala, CryptoKeyValidation.scala, KMS drivers, PostQuantumCryptoIntegrationTest.scala (enableExperimental)
Canton release notes v3.7.0 and v3.6.3: no PQ mention
forum.canton.network: 'DA Position on Post-Quantum Cryptography' (2025-04-14, update 2026-08-26)
Global Synchronizer Scan API (sv-1 on sync.global and digitalasset.com): 403 for unauthenticated requests

no_probe_reason.en: No free public endpoint returns the latest block: the Global Synchronizer's Scan APIs answered 403 without credentials on 2026-11-27, and the explorer APIs need paid keys. Canton orders transactions on a sequencer rather than in a public chain of blocks.
no_probe_reason.zh: 没有免费的公开接口能读到最新区块：2026-11-27 未登录访问 Global Synchronizer 的 Scan 接口返回 403，区块浏览器的接口需要付费密钥。Canton 由排序器给交易排序，没有公开的区块链。

chains.name: Bittensor

algo.en: ML-DSA-65 (FIPS 204) and original Falcon-512/1024 (not FN-DSA), opt-in
algo.zh: ML-DSA-65（FIPS 204）与原版 Falcon-512/1024（不是 FN-DSA），可选用

consensus.en: Proof of stake: TAO is staked to validators; blocks by Aura and GRANDPA
consensus.zh: 权益证明：TAO 质押给验证者；出块用 Aura 和 GRANDPA

holder_can_use_today.en: A holder can create an ML-DSA-65 or Falcon wallet with btcli and move TAO into it. Transactions from that account are authorized by the post-quantum signature.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 持币人可以用 btcli 创建 ML-DSA-65 或 Falcon 钱包，把 TAO 转进去；这个账户发出的交易由抗量子签名授权。

note.en: Existing Sr25519/Ed25519 accounts are not converted. Funds stay classically protected until the holder moves them to a new post-quantum account, and Falcon here is the original format, not the final FN-DSA standard.
note.zh: 现有的 Sr25519/Ed25519 账户不会自动转换，持币人要自己把资金转到新的抗量子账户才算数；这里的 Falcon 是原始格式，不是最终的 FN-DSA 标准。

today.en: A holder can create an ML-DSA-65 or Falcon wallet with btcli and move TAO into it. Transactions from that account are authorized by the post-quantum signature.
today.zh: 持币人可以用 btcli 创建 ML-DSA-65 或 Falcon 钱包，把 TAO 转进去；这个账户发出的交易由抗量子签名授权。

watch.en: Existing Sr25519/Ed25519 accounts are not converted. Funds stay classically protected until the holder moves them to a new post-quantum account, and Falcon here is the original format, not the final FN-DSA standard.
watch.zh: 现有的 Sr25519/Ed25519 账户不会自动转换，持币人要自己把资金转到新的抗量子账户才算数；这里的 Falcon 是原始格式，不是最终的 FN-DSA 标准。

can.en: Create a fixed or rotating ML-DSA-65 / Falcon-512 / Falcon-1024 wallet and send, stake and use subnets from it (per the design docs). Not verified here: a live mainnet transaction signed this way.
can.zh: 创建固定或轮换的 ML-DSA-65 / Falcon-512 / Falcon-1024 钱包，并用它转账、质押、使用子网（据设计文档）。本次未核实：主网上是否已有用这种签名发出的真实交易。

next.en: Whether the post-quantum account types become the default in btcli and the SDK (stage 5), and the final FN-DSA standard for Falcon.
next.zh: btcli 和 SDK 是否把抗量子账户设为默认（第 5 阶段），以及 Falcon 对应的最终 FN-DSA 标准。

stage_basis.en: Since runtime 488, holders can opt in to ML-DSA-65 or Falcon accounts on mainnet; the switch that enables them is on. Sr25519 and Ed25519 stay the default.
stage_basis.zh: 自运行时版本 488 起，持币人可以在主网上选用 ML-DSA-65 或 Falcon 账户，启用开关已打开；默认仍是 Sr25519 和 Ed25519。

event.en: Mainnet switched on hashed accounts, which allow ML-DSA-65 and Falcon keys, at block 9,484,619. This site read an archive node on 2026-11-27: the switch is unset at block 9,484,618 and on at block 9,484,619.
event.zh: 主网在第 9,484,619 个区块打开哈希账户开关，允许使用 ML-DSA-65 和 Falcon 密钥。本站 2026-11-27 读取归档节点：第 9,484,618 个区块时开关未设置，第 9,484,619 个区块时已打开。

latest_step.text: Release v488 ships 'Release 487 - Quantum Resistant Wallets' (ML-DSA-65 and Falcon wallets).
latest_step.zh: v488 版本发布，包含「Release 487 - 抗量子钱包」（ML-DSA-65 与 Falcon 钱包）。

milestones.name: PR #3220 opened: ML-DSA-65 and Falcon wallets plus optional key rotation, by the core maintainers.
milestones.zh: 提交 PR #3220：加入 ML-DSA-65 与 Falcon 钱包以及可选的密钥轮换，由核心维护者提交。

milestones.name: PR #3291 'Release 487 - Quantum Resistant Wallets' merged into main.
milestones.zh: PR #3291「Release 487 - 抗量子钱包」合并进主分支。

milestones.name: Release v488 published; its notes list PR #3291.
milestones.zh: v488 发布，发布说明列出了 PR #3291。

milestones.name: Mainnet turns on hashed accounts, which allow ML-DSA-65 and Falcon keys, at block 9,484,619 (17:46 UTC). An archive-node read by this site shows AdminUtils.HashedAccountsEnabled unset at block 9,484,618 and true at block 9,484,619.
milestones.zh: 主网在第 9,484,619 个区块（UTC 17:46）打开哈希账户开关，允许使用 ML-DSA-65 和 Falcon 密钥。本站读取归档节点：第 9,484,618 个区块时 AdminUtils.HashedAccountsEnabled 未设置，第 9,484,619 个区块时为开启。

milestones.name: Mainnet RPC reports runtime node-subtensor 497 and AdminUtils.HashedAccountsEnabled = 0x01 (the switch that gates the new account types).
milestones.zh: 主网 RPC 返回运行时 node-subtensor 497，且 AdminUtils.HashedAccountsEnabled = 0x01（控制新账户类型的开关已打开）。

milestones.name: Design docs: ML-DSA-65 pure mode per FIPS 204; Falcon uses the original padded format.
milestones.zh: 设计文档：ML-DSA-65 采用 FIPS 204 的纯模式；Falcon 使用原始填充格式。

claim.en: A mainnet transaction signed with an ML-DSA or Falcon account.
claim.zh: 主网上存在由 ML-DSA 或 Falcon 账户签名的交易。

reason.en: We read the runtime version and the enable switch, but did not decode blocks for such a transaction.
reason.zh: 我们读到了运行时版本和开关状态，但没有解码区块去找这类交易。

relation.zh: Bittensor 背后的 Opentensor 基金会官方号
relation.en: Official account of the Opentensor Foundation, behind Bittensor

stage_basis.en: Mainnet splendor-quantum-1 answers on its public RPC (height 4,256,348 at 2026-11-27T14:06Z). The node code signs every native transaction, block and validator vote with ML-DSA-65 (core/crypto/mldsa.go) and derives every address from an ML-DSA-65 public key; there is no ECDSA account type on this chain.
stage_basis.zh: 主网 splendor-quantum-1 的公开 RPC 能连上（2026-11-27T14:06Z 高度 4,256,348）。节点代码用 ML-DSA-65 签署每笔原生交易、每个区块和每次验证者投票（core/crypto/mldsa.go），所有地址都由 ML-DSA-65 公钥派生；这条链没有 ECDSA 账户类型。

chains.name: Qbit

algo.en: SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s-bounded30: a reduced-usage SLH-DSA profile (3,680-byte signatures, 2^30 signatures per key)
algo.zh: SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s-bounded30：限次使用的 SLH-DSA 变体（签名 3,680 字节，每把密钥最多 2^30 次签名）

consensus.zh: 工作量证明（PoW，SHA-256，支持 AuxPoW 合并挖矿）

holder_can_use_today.en: QBT sits in P2MR outputs that hide the spend key until first use, and every spend carries a hash-based SLH-DSA-family signature. There are no elliptic-curve spend paths on the launch chain.
holder_can_use_today.zh: QBT 存放在 P2MR 输出里，首次花费前不暴露花费公钥；每次花费都带一个基于哈希的 SLH-DSA 系签名。上线链上没有椭圆曲线花费路径。

note.en: The profile is not a FIPS 205 parameter set: FIPS 205 SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s signatures are 7,856 bytes, this one is 3,680 bytes and is designed for at most 2^30 signatures per key. That limit is a wallet rule, not a consensus rule: consensus verifiers keep no usage counter. The wallet tracks that limit per descriptor copy, so using one key in several wallets can exceed it.
note.zh: 这个参数集不是 FIPS 205 标准参数：标准 SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s 签名为 7,856 字节，这里只有 3,680 字节，每把密钥按设计最多只能签 2^30 次。这个上限是钱包规则，不是共识规则：共识验证不记使用次数。钱包按每份描述符副本计数，同一把密钥放进多个钱包可能超限。

today.en: QBT sits in P2MR outputs that hide the spend key until first use, and every spend carries a hash-based SLH-DSA-family signature. There are no elliptic-curve spend paths on the launch chain.
today.zh: QBT 存放在 P2MR 输出里，首次花费前不暴露花费公钥；每次花费都带一个基于哈希的 SLH-DSA 系签名。上线链上没有椭圆曲线花费路径。

watch.en: The profile is not a FIPS 205 parameter set: FIPS 205 SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s signatures are 7,856 bytes, this one is 3,680 bytes and is designed for at most 2^30 signatures per key. That limit is a wallet rule, not a consensus rule: consensus verifiers keep no usage counter. The wallet tracks that limit per descriptor copy, so using one key in several wallets can exceed it.
watch.zh: 这个参数集不是 FIPS 205 标准参数：标准 SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s 签名为 7,856 字节，这里只有 3,680 字节，每把密钥按设计最多只能签 2^30 次。这个上限是钱包规则，不是共识规则：共识验证不记使用次数。钱包按每份描述符副本计数，同一把密钥放进多个钱包可能超限。

can.en: Hold QBT in Qbit Core or the Qbit Wallet Chrome extension and receive to fresh P2MR addresses; keep each key in one wallet only.
can.zh: 用 Qbit Core 或 Qbit Wallet 浏览器扩展持有 QBT，用新的 P2MR 地址收款；每把密钥只放在一个钱包里。

next.en: Any soft fork that activates one of the reserved P2MR leaf versions for another signature system.
next.zh: 启用 P2MR 预留叶版本、以支持其他签名方案的软分叉。

stage_basis.en: Mainnet runs restricted-output mode from genesis (fRestrictedOutputMode = true, P2MR active at height 0), so new outputs are P2MR and spends are authorized by OP_CHECKSIGPQC with the SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s-bounded30 profile; legacy CHECKSIG fails inside P2MR. The chain is live (height 193,900 at 2026-11-27T14:07Z).
stage_basis.zh: 主网从创世起就运行受限输出模式（fRestrictedOutputMode = true，P2MR 在高度 0 生效），所以新输出都是 P2MR，花费由 OP_CHECKSIGPQC 按 SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s-bounded30 参数授权；P2MR 内的旧式 CHECKSIG 会失败。链在运行（2026-11-27T14:07Z 高度 193,900）。

event.en: Genesis block time, fixed in the node's chain parameters; P2MR outputs are active from block 0.
event.zh: 创世区块时间写在节点的链参数里；P2MR 输出从第 0 个区块起生效。

algo.en: ML-DSA-65 (FIPS 204) spend and block signatures; ML-KEM-768 (FIPS 203) output delivery
algo.zh: ML-DSA-65（FIPS 204）用于花费和区块签名；ML-KEM-768（FIPS 203）用于输出投递

holder_can_use_today.en: Every XDS output belongs to an ML-DSA-65 spend key and every spend carries an ML-DSA-65 signature; the chain has no elliptic-curve outputs to migrate.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 每个 XDS 输出都归属一把 ML-DSA-65 花费密钥，每次花费都带 ML-DSA-65 签名；链上没有需要日后迁移的椭圆曲线输出。

note.en: Spending reveals the long-term spend key, so spends under one identity are linkable; amounts are public in Phase 1; finality is a node-local 10-block first-seen rule. The project itself says independent review of the cryptographic composition is still desirable.
note.zh: 花费会暴露长期花费公钥，同一身份下的花费可被关联；第一阶段金额公开；最终性是节点本地的 10 个区块先见规则。项目自己也写明，密码学组合仍需要独立审查。

today.en: Every XDS output belongs to an ML-DSA-65 spend key and every spend carries an ML-DSA-65 signature; the chain has no elliptic-curve outputs to migrate.
today.zh: 每个 XDS 输出都归属一把 ML-DSA-65 花费密钥，每次花费都带 ML-DSA-65 签名；链上没有需要日后迁移的椭圆曲线输出。

chains.name: Parano1d

algo.en: Custom construction: hash-based zero-knowledge spend proofs (Poseidon2b; FROST-GKR and FRI-Binius); no public-key signatures
algo.zh: 项目自研构造：基于哈希的零知识花费证明（Poseidon2b；FROST-GKR 与 FRI-Binius）；不使用公钥签名

consensus.zh: 工作量证明（PoW，Poseidon2b），状态由证明验证

holder_can_use_today.en: A NOID holder controls coins through a secret, not a key pair; every spend proves knowledge of that secret in zero knowledge, and no public key or signature appears on chain.
holder_can_use_today.zh: NOID 持币人用一个秘密值而不是密钥对控制币；每次花费都以零知识方式证明知道这个秘密，链上不出现公钥和签名。

note.en: The proof system and the Poseidon2b hash are the project's own design with no NIST or IETF standard; 'NIST PQC Category 1' is the project's own conditional assessment, not an external certification. Peer identities in P2P use Ed25519. Through block 3,223,778, block subsidies are split 90% to miners, 5% to the O(1) Network Fund and 5% to Parano1d Lab. The author is pseudonymous, the repository has 2 contributors, and no audit is published.
note.zh: 证明系统和 Poseidon2b 哈希都是项目自行设计，没有 NIST 或 IETF 标准；「NIST PQC Category 1」是项目在自设前提下的评估，不是外部认证。P2P 层的节点身份使用 Ed25519。到第 3,223,778 号区块为止，区块补贴按 90% 给矿工、5% 给 O(1) Network Fund、5% 给 Parano1d Lab 分配。作者使用化名，代码库只有 2 位贡献者，没有公开的审计报告。

today.en: A NOID holder controls coins through a secret, not a key pair; every spend proves knowledge of that secret in zero knowledge, and no public key or signature appears on chain.
today.zh: NOID 持币人用一个秘密值而不是密钥对控制币；每次花费都以零知识方式证明知道这个秘密，链上不出现公钥和签名。

watch.en: The proof system and the Poseidon2b hash are the project's own design with no NIST or IETF standard; 'NIST PQC Category 1' is the project's own conditional assessment, not an external certification. Peer identities in P2P use Ed25519.
watch.zh: 证明系统和 Poseidon2b 哈希都是项目自行设计，没有 NIST 或 IETF 标准；「NIST PQC Category 1」是项目在自设前提下的评估，不是外部认证。P2P 层的节点身份使用 Ed25519。

can.en: Hold NOID in the official desktop or web wallet and send proof-authorized transfers; keep the master secret (or the photo it was derived from) private and backed up.
can.zh: 用官方桌面钱包或网页钱包持有 NOID 并发起证明授权的转账；主秘密（或派生它的照片）要保密并备份。

note.zh: 10 个验证者全部由 Aere 基金会运营，尚无完成的第三方审计；节点间传输和每条共识消息的一部分仍使用 secp256k1（项目自己公布的局限）。

today.en: A holder can move funds to an account created from an ML-DSA key and spend it with type-0x50 transactions that carry no classical signature. Ordinary secp256k1 accounts, the default, stay exposed.

can.zh: 用项目开源的签名库生成 ML-DSA 账户，再用 0x50 类型交易把资金转过去；先确认所用钱包和库能读取 0x50 类型交易。

next.en: Making ML-DSA accounts the default (stage 5), AIP-22 stage E (removing the remaining ECDSA from consensus messages) and a third-party audit.
next.zh: 把 ML-DSA 账户设为默认（第 5 档）、AIP-22 E 阶段（去掉共识消息中剩余的 ECDSA）以及第三方审计。

stage_basis.en: AIP-20, a Draft in the project's own AIP repository that has not been approved, defines type-0x50 transactions authorized only by ML-DSA-44/65/87. It is armed on chain 2800 from block 19,900,000, and block 19,900,028 (2026-09-23) contains a type-0x50 transaction (project explorer). Ordinary secp256k1 accounts remain the default, so PQ protection is opt-in.
stage_basis.zh: AIP-20 是项目自己 AIP 仓库里的草案，尚未批准，定义了只能用 ML-DSA-44/65/87 授权的 0x50 类交易；它在链 2800 上从区块 19,900,000 起生效，区块 19,900,028（2026-09-23）里有一笔 0x50 类交易（项目自己的区块浏览器）。普通 secp256k1 账户仍是默认，所以抗量子保护是可选的。

algo.zh: 混合签名：经典签名 + ML-DSA-87（FIPS 204），两者都必需

holder_can_use_today.en: On mainnet, transfers on the Cosmos lane must carry an ML-DSA-87 signature in addition to the classical one; an account without a registered PQ key cannot use the EVM lane at all.
holder_can_use_today.zh: 主网上，Cosmos 通道的转账除经典签名外还必须带 ML-DSA-87 签名；没有登记抗量子密钥的账户完全不能使用 EVM 通道。

note.en: Inside an open EVM window (up to 17,280 blocks, 1,000 transactions and a set outflow cap), EVM transactions are authorized by secp256k1 alone. Validator consensus keys on mainnet are Ed25519.
note.zh: EVM 窗口开启期间（最多 17,280 个区块、1,000 笔交易和设定的流出上限），EVM 交易只靠 secp256k1 授权。主网验证者的共识密钥是 Ed25519。

today.en: On mainnet, transfers on the Cosmos lane must carry an ML-DSA-87 signature in addition to the classical one; an account without a registered PQ key cannot use the EVM lane at all.
today.zh: 主网上，Cosmos 通道的转账除经典签名外还必须带 ML-DSA-87 签名；没有登记抗量子密钥的账户完全不能使用 EVM 通道。

watch.en: Inside an open EVM window (up to 17,280 blocks, 1,000 transactions and a set outflow cap), EVM transactions are authorized by secp256k1 alone. Validator consensus keys on mainnet are Ed25519.

can.en: Register an ML-DSA-87 key for the account with the wallet adapter and send hybrid-signed transfers; keep EVM windows short and their outflow caps small.
can.zh: 用钱包适配器为账户登记 ML-DSA-87 密钥并发起混合签名转账；EVM 窗口尽量短、流出上限尽量小。

next.en: Moving validator consensus keys off Ed25519, and any governance change to hybrid_signature_mode.
next.zh: 验证者共识密钥是否换掉 Ed25519，以及治理对 hybrid_signature_mode 的任何修改。

stage_basis.en: The x/pqc defaults in qorechain-core v3.2.8, which the mainnet init script does not override: hybrid_signature_mode = required, allow_classical_fallback = false, default algorithm Dilithium-5 (ML-DSA-87). Cosmos-lane transactions therefore need an ML-DSA-87 signature alongside the classical one, and the EVM lane only accepts transactions inside a window opened by a PQ-signed message (README). Inside an open window, EVM transactions are authorized by secp256k1 alone.
stage_basis.zh: qorechain-core v3.2.8 中 x/pqc 的默认参数（主网初始化脚本没有改动）：hybrid_signature_mode = required，allow_classical_fallback = false，默认算法 Dilithium-5（ML-DSA-87）。所以 Cosmos 通道的交易除传统签名外还必须带 ML-DSA-87 签名；EVM 通道只接受在抗量子签名消息开启的时间窗口内提交的交易（见 README）。窗口开启期间，EVM 交易只靠 secp256k1 授权。

event.zh: 主网 qorechain-vladi 的第 1 个区块。截至 2026-11-27，链上参数要求包含 ML-DSA-87 的混合签名；是否从第 1 个区块起就如此，未核实。

chains.name: Minima

algo.en: Winternitz one-time signatures in a Merkle key tree (TreeKey; SHA3-256, w = 8)
algo.zh: Winternitz 一次性签名组成的 Merkle 密钥树（TreeKey；SHA3-256，w = 8）

holder_can_use_today.en: Every MINIMA coin is spent with a hash-based Winternitz signature from the owner's key tree; there is no elliptic-curve path. A default key allows 262,144 signatures (64 keys per level, 3 levels).
holder_can_use_today.zh: 每枚 MINIMA 都用持币人密钥树中的 Winternitz 哈希签名花费，没有椭圆曲线路径。默认密钥可签 262,144 次（每层 64 把密钥，共 3 层）。

note.en: Winternitz keys are one-time: reusing one weakens it, so the wallet must track which keys have been used (TreeKey keeps a use counter). The construction is the project's own combination of Winternitz signatures and a key tree, not a standardized scheme such as XMSS or LMS.
note.zh: Winternitz 密钥只能用一次：重复使用会削弱保护，所以钱包必须记录哪些密钥已经用过（TreeKey 有使用计数）。这套构造是项目自己把 Winternitz 签名和密钥树组合起来的，不是 XMSS、LMS 这类标准方案。

today.en: Every MINIMA coin is spent with a hash-based Winternitz signature from the owner's key tree; there is no elliptic-curve path. A default key allows 262,144 signatures (64 keys per level, 3 levels).
today.zh: 每枚 MINIMA 都用持币人密钥树中的 Winternitz 哈希签名花费，没有椭圆曲线路径。默认密钥可签 262,144 次（每层 64 把密钥，共 3 层）。

watch.zh: Winternitz 密钥只能用一次：重复使用会削弱保护，所以钱包必须记录哪些密钥已经用过（TreeKey 有使用计数）。这套构造是项目自己把 Winternitz 签名和密钥树组合起来的，不是 XMSS、LMS 这类标准方案。

can.en: Run a node or use the official wallet; avoid running the same seed on two nodes at once so the key-use counter stays in step.
can.zh: 运行节点或使用官方钱包；不要在两个节点上同时运行同一个种子，以免密钥使用计数不同步。

next.en: Repository activity (last push 2026-08-31) and any change to the default key tree.
next.zh: 代码仓动态（最近一次推送是 2026-08-31）以及默认密钥树的任何改动。

stage_basis.en: Coins are locked by KISS VM scripts whose signature functions (CHECKSIG, SIGNEDBY, MULTISIG) verify Minima's TreeKey signatures, built from Winternitz one-time signatures (BouncyCastle WinternitzOTSignature, SHA3-256, w = 8); the node source tree at the pinned commit has no ECDSA or secp256k1 code. Mainnet is running: explorer.minima.global showed block 2,442,018 at 2026-11-27T14:34Z.
stage_basis.zh: 币由 KISS VM 脚本锁定，脚本里的签名函数（CHECKSIG、SIGNEDBY、MULTISIG）验证 Minima 的 TreeKey 签名，TreeKey 由 Winternitz 一次性签名构成（BouncyCastle WinternitzOTSignature，SHA3-256，w = 8）；固定提交版本的节点源码里没有 ECDSA 或 secp256k1 代码。主网在运行：explorer.minima.global 显示 2026-11-27T14:34Z 区块 2,442,018。

latest_step.text: Latest commit to the node repository (version 1.0.49.4 merge). A later push on 2026-08-31 added no newer commit.
latest_step.zh: 节点代码库最近一次提交（1.0.49.4 版本合并）。2026-08-31 的推送没有带来更新的提交。

milestones.name: Latest node commit; signatures remain Winternitz-based TreeKey.
milestones.zh: 节点代码最近一次提交；签名仍是基于 Winternitz 的 TreeKey。

milestones.zh: 已核：主网区块浏览器显示区块 2,442,018（平均出块时间 49.2 秒）。

claim.en: Mainnet launch date: CoinMarketCap lists 2024-11-26 as the coin's launch date; a community timeline places mainnet in 2022 or 2023.
claim.zh: 主网上线日期：CoinMarketCap 记的上线日期是 2024-11-26；一个社区整理的时间线把主网放在 2022 或 2023 年。

reason.en: Third-party sources disagree, and no project source with a date was found (minima.global posts, the project Substack archive, the explorer).
reason.zh: 第三方来源说法不一，也没找到项目自己写明日期的出处（minima.global 文章、项目 Substack 存档、区块浏览器）。

network.block_interval_note: No published target; averageBlockTime was 49.23 s on the explorer on 2026-11-27.

migration.en: Minima coins are spent with Winternitz hash-based signatures from a key tree, and the node has no elliptic-curve code, so there are no classical-key coins to move.
migration.zh: Minima 的币用密钥树里的 Winternitz 哈希签名花费，节点里没有椭圆曲线代码，没有传统密钥下的币需要迁移。

audit.en: Hacken's January 2023 audit listed signing and verification in scope, but the key-tree signing code has changed since, most recently in September 2025.
audit.zh: Hacken 2023 年 1 月的审计把签名与验签列入范围，但密钥树签名代码之后又改过，最近一次在 2025 年 9 月。

fund.en: Tokenized fund, loan pool or commodity
fund.zh: 代币化基金、贷款池或大宗商品

exchange.en: Exchange token with no network of its own
exchange.zh: 交易所代币，没有自己的网络

app.en: App or DeFi token that runs on another chain
app.zh: 运行在别的链上的应用或 DeFi 代币

governance.en: Governance token; the network’s fees are paid in another coin
governance.zh: 治理代币；所在网络的手续费用别的币支付

meme.en: Meme token with no network of its own
meme.zh: meme 代币，没有自己的网络

note.en: Shibarium pays fees in BONE, not SHIB.
note.zh: Shibarium 的手续费用 BONE 支付，不是 SHIB。

not_listed.name: BlackRock USD Institutional Digital Liquidity Fund

note.en: Fees on World Chain are paid in ETH; WLD is not the fee or staking coin.
note.zh: World Chain 的手续费用 ETH 支付，WLD 不是手续费币，也不用于质押。

note.en: Fees on Arbitrum One are paid in ETH; ARB is used for governance.
note.zh: Arbitrum One 的手续费用 ETH 支付，ARB 只用于治理。

not_listed.name: Invesco Short Duration US Government Securities Fund
Janus Henderson Anemoy AAA CLO Fund
Spiko EU T-Bills Money Market Fund

note.en: RAIN is the token of a prediction-market and options protocol that runs on Arbitrum; it is not the gas or staking coin of a network of its own.
note.zh: RAIN 是运行在 Arbitrum 上的预测市场与期权协议的代币，不是任何独立网络的燃料币或质押币。

note.en: ENA is the governance and staking token of the Ethena protocol on Ethereum; Converge (planned gas in USDe/USDtb, validators staking ENA) has no primary-source mainnet record, and Ethena's docs do not mention it.
note.zh: ENA 是以太坊上 Ethena 协议的治理与质押代币；Converge（计划用 USDe/USDtb 付燃料费、验证者质押 ENA）查不到官方主网记录，Ethena 文档中也没有提到。

note.en: ONDO is the governance token of Ondo's tokenized-asset products on Ethereum; Ondo's July 2026 post says the Ondo Network is not a blockchain, so there is no chain of its own.
note.zh: ONDO 是 Ondo 代币化资产产品在以太坊上的治理代币；Ondo 2026 年 7 月的官方文章明确说 Ondo Network 并不是区块链，因此没有自己的主链。

note.en: ASTER is the token of the Aster exchange; on Aster Chain gas is zero per Aster's docs, and Phase 1 validators are run by the team (external validators not yet supported).
note.zh: ASTER 是 Aster 交易所的代币；按 Aster 官方文档，Aster Chain 上的燃料费为零，且第一阶段验证者由团队运行（尚不支持外部验证者）。

note.en: BGB is Bitget's exchange token; Morph's explorer still reports ETH as its native coin, and Morph's own post describes BGB as gas only in future tense.
note.zh: BGB 是 Bitget 的平台币；Morph 的区块浏览器仍以 ETH 为原生币，Morph 官方文章对 BGB 作燃料币也只是将来时。

note.en: PIEVERSE is a BEP-20/ERC-20 token of a payments project that runs on BNB Chain; it is not the gas or staking coin of its own network.
note.zh: PIEVERSE 是运行在 BNB Chain 上的支付项目的 BEP-20/ERC-20 代币，不是自有网络的燃料币或质押币。

note.en: Midnight pays fees in DUST, a resource that NIGHT generates, not in NIGHT itself, and block production is still run by federated node operators, so NIGHT neither pays fees nor secures consensus today.
note.zh: Midnight 用 NIGHT 生成的 DUST 付手续费，而不是 NIGHT 本身，且目前出块仍由联盟节点运营方负责，所以 NIGHT 现在既不付手续费，也不保护共识。

note.en: LIT is the staking and fee-discount token of the Lighter exchange; Lighter's docs describe no gas or consensus role for it.
note.zh: LIT 是 Lighter 交易所的质押与手续费折扣代币；Lighter 文档中没有它作燃料币或共识质押币的说明。
